jobs.title: Senior AI Specialist (Operations) (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
Doctolib sucht Dich ab sofort als Senior AI Specialist (x/f/m) für unseren Standort in Berlin.

Doctolib wird zu einem AI-native Unternehmen. Wir gestalten unsere Arbeitsweise Workflow für Workflow neu – und suchen Menschen, die diese Transformation nicht nur mittragen, sondern aktiv bauen. Als Senior AI Specialist bist Du der/die technische Umsetzungskraft und AI-Ops Owner hinter der KI-gestützten Produktivität unserer Operations- und Customer-Success-Teams.

Du arbeitest im Founder- und Product-Mode: Du besitzt einen Workflow end-to-end – vom Kontext über das Agenten-Design bis zur Evaluation – und hebst ihn Schritt für Schritt auf ein höheres Maß an Automatisierung. Unser Anspruch: weg von manueller Einzelfallarbeit, hin zu Workflows, die weitgehend autonom laufen und dabei die Qualitätslatte halten. So trägst Du direkt zu unserer Mission bei, die Gesundheitsversorgung für alle zu verbessern.


DEINE AUFGABEN

 - Workflow-Redesign statt reiner Automatisierung: Du analysierst die kritischsten Operations- und Customer-Success-Workflows, zerlegst zeitintensive Prozesse mit geringem Urteilsbedarf und transformierst diese durch den Einsatz von KI-Agenten. Dabei setzt Du klare Ziele für Autonomie sowie Qualität und entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter.

 - KI-Agenten als Produkte bauen & betreiben: Du entwickelst und steuerst Agenten auf Plattformen wie Dust oder Claude. Jeder Agent wird mit einer festen Baseline sowie relevanten Metriken wie Benefit, Usage und Scalability produktiv gesetzt.

 - Knowledge & Context Management: Du kuratierst gezielt den Kontext, den Agenten benötigen – von Templates bis zu Kern-Daten. Dabei gilt: Qualität vor Quantität. Du stellst sicher, dass Wissensquellen in Confluence, Drive oder Salesforce stets aktuell und sauber strukturiert sind.

 - Evaluation & Qualitätssicherung: Du definierst Qualitätsstandards und etablierst Eval-Routinen, um Schwachstellen wie Halluzinationen oder Prompt-Drift frühzeitig zu beheben. Durch systematisches Nutzerfeedback und A/B-Tests optimierst Du die Prompts kontinuierlich.

 - CRM- & Daten-Integration: Du verantwortest die Schnittstellen zwischen CRM-Systemen wie Salesforce und unseren KI-Plattformen. Du automatisierst Datenflüsse und arbeitest eng mit der IT zusammen, um neue, wertvolle Datenquellen für die Agenten zu erschließen.

 - Zentrale Schnittstelle & Enablement: Du übersetzt Business-Anforderungen in technische Lösungen und bringst Stakeholder aus Leadership, IT und Product zusammen. Dabei steigerst Du die AI Fluency im Team in den Bereichen Context, Agent Management und Evaluation.

 - Impact & Measurement: Anstatt neue KPIs zu erfinden, machst Du den Erfolg der KI anhand bestehender Metriken wie Zeit, Qualität und Kosten messbar und steuerst so die nächsten Skalierungsschritte.
jobs.requirements_raw:
DEIN PROFIL

Da produktive KI-Workflows und Agenten-Technologien noch jung sind, ist jahrelange Expertise am Markt eine Seltenheit. Wir setzen daher gezielt auf Potenzial vor reinen Dienstjahren: Entscheidend für uns sind Deine Auffassungsgabe, ein ausgeprägtes Produkt-Mindset sowie Dein Urteilsvermögen. Falls Du brennst und die nötigen Skills mitbringst, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung – selbst wenn Dein Profil nicht jeden einzelnen Aspekt perfekt abdeckt.


UM TEIL UNSERES TEAMS ZU WERDEN, BRINGST DU FOLGENDES MIT:

 - Lerngeschwindigkeit & Produktions-Denken: Du hast Dich aus dem Stand in ein neues technisches Feld eingearbeitet und etwas Echtes gebaut, das Menschen wirklich genutzt haben. Du kannst präzise beschreiben, was schiefging (Halluzinationen, Prompt-Drift, veraltete Daten, Kosten) und wie Du es gelöst hast.

 - Evaluations-Instinkt: Du vertraust nicht auf „sieht gut aus“, sondern definierst eine Qualitätslatte und misst dagegen – Automatisierung und Qualität gehören für Dich zusammen.

 - Ownership & Kommunikation: Du übernimmst ein Problem end-to-end, priorisierst hart, fühlst Dich in Ambiguität wohl und machst technische Sachverhalte für nicht-technische Stakeholder verständlich.

 - Technisches & Daten-Verständnis: Du liest und passt Skripte an, verstehst APIs, Webhooks und Automatisierungs-Tools (Make, n8n, Zapier) und weißt, wie CRM-Daten (idealerweise Salesforce) in KI-Systeme fließen.

 - Kommunikationsstärke: Sichere Sprachkenntnisse in Englisch, um in unserem internationalen Umfeld auf höchstem Niveau zu agieren. Deutsch auf Level B1 genügt.


BESONDERS INTERESSANT SIND FÜR UNS AUSSERDEM: 

 - Agenten-Plattform Expertise: Du verfügst über praktische Erfahrung mit Systemen wie Dust, Claude oder LangChain. Da sich Tools schnell wandeln, setzen wir primär auf Dein Prozessverständnis und Deine Evaluations-Skills als nachhaltiges Fundament.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Java/Python - Backend Platform Team (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Mid level Java Software Engineer, with strong experience in Java and Spring Boot, to join Doctolib’s Platform team, ATP. The team builds the backend foundations that power our distributed services. Java and Spring Boot will be your primary technologies. As part of a polyglot platform, you may also contribute to Python services, tooling, and cross-cutting initiatives.

ATP is part of the Platform domain, whose mission is to build and maintain the common building blocks of our system with a "Platform as a Product" mindset. We abstract and simplify the use of these complex, critical components, enabling product teams to focus on their core mission: building products faster for healthcare professionals and patients.

At ATP, we focus specifically on distributed services (chassis, archetypes, business-agnostic services, cross-cutting concerns) with a strong emphasis on quality, scalability, and usability. All Doctolib product teams build their features on top of the foundations we provide, leveraging the components we design to accelerate development while ensuring the highest standards of quality, compliance, and security.

As Java Software Engineer, and within a team of 8 engineers, you will be responsible for designing and delivering essential components that empower Doctolib teams to build robust and scalable services. 

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

 - Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define and implement features to improve the Doctolib platform

 - Take a leading role within the team and contribute to establishing a technical vision that ensures the performance, security, and usability of the platform, taking into account the future needs and the high scalability needs

 - Bring your expertise and experiences to help us continuously improve the way we implement, test, and monitor high-quality features

 - Improving the performance of key features implemented in Java, sometimes completely challenging the status quo

 - Taking leadership on delivering roadmap items (together with the team)

 - Contributing to establishing a technical vision and co-drive the creation of the roadmap for next quarters


ABOUT OUR TECH ENVIRONMENT

 - Our chassis powers more than 50 services across the Doctolib platform

 - Our stack is composed of Java, Python, Spring boot, Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL, K8S, Datadog.

 - Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements

 - We leverage AI in an ethical manner across our products to empower patients and health professionals. We are looking for a Senior DataOps Engineer to join the Data and AI Platform team.

Your mission will be to improve and maintain an efficient, reliable and scalable platform that enables Data Product developers and owners to develop, deploy and maintain their data products autonomously, at scale, with clear and maintained interfaces and full observability — ensuring seamless data flow across the organisation and enabling data-driven decision-making.

 - Contribute to the continuous improvement of platform architecture, scalability, and developer experience across teams

We are looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our SRE team dedicated to platform reliability within Platform Engineering.

Your mission will be to ensure Doctolib's platform remains reliable, scalable, and resilient at a European scale across infrastructure, observability, and cross-cutting reliability initiatives. You will work within a team driving reliability standards across 170+ applications, contributing directly to supporting 520,000 health professionals and 90 million patients in their daily healthcare journey.

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

 - Build and maintain infrastructure automation and infrastructure-as-code at scale, with a strong focus on consistency, reliability, and developer experience across 170+ applications

 - Take part in the on-call rotation, and actively contribute to improving our on-call experience by reducing noise and ensuring actionable telemetry

 - Partner with software engineering teams to embed reliability practices early in the development lifecycle

 - Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

 - Einen Firmenwagen – auch privat nutzbar, versteuert nach der 1%-Regelung

Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Team, das gewinnen will. Du auch? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt und werde Teil der Doctolib-Erfolgsgeschichte! Weitere Informationen zum Arbeitsalltag im Sales bei Doctolib findest Du hier https://careers.doctolib.de/sales/. 



Der Interview-Prozess

 - Vollzeit

 - Arbeitsort: Frankfurt

Wir verfolgen die Vision, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Dies spiegelt sich auch im Recruiting wider. Wir evaluieren Bewerbungen ausschließlich auf der Grundlage von Qualifikation und Motivation. Diskriminierung wird bei uns nicht toleriert.

jobs.title: Field Sales Partner - Ferrara (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
QUALE SARÀ IL TUO RUOLO 

Doctolib è alla ricerca di un/una Field Sales Partner per unirsi al team e sviluppare le attività commerciali nella zona di Ferrara e Rovigo.

Come Field Sales Partner, farai parte di un team di professionisti impegnati sul campo a semplificare, attraverso le nostre soluzioni, la vita del personale sanitario e l’accesso alle cure delle persone.

In questo ruolo, sarai il primo punto di contatto tra Doctolib e i medici del territorio e seguirai tutto il ciclo di vendita dei servizi offerti da Doctolib.

In particolare ti occuperai di:

Prospecting:

 - Contattare i medici nella tua zona (con chiamate a freddo, email e visite in presenza) per generare nuove opportunità in modo scalabile

 - Qualificare i lead gestendo follow-up cadenzati per far avanzare la pipeline con continuità

Appuntamenti, demo e conversione:

 - Visitare gli studi dei medici e condurre demo, focalizzandosi sui benefici più rilevanti per la pratica

 - Gestire domande e obiezioni guidando il prospect verso una decisione rapida

Chiusura e handover:

 - Presentare l’offerta e portare la trattativa fino alla firma, con un ciclo di vendita breve

 - Essere il punto di riferimento del medico durante l'installazione e il training iniziale del prodotto

 - Assicurare un handover puntuale al team di onboarding per un avvio fluido

Pipeline e KPI:

Durante tutti gli step di vendita avrai modo di raccogliere feedback sia dai tuoi colleghi che dai clienti. Sarà importante per condividere best practices e suggerimenti per migliorare le attività del team Sales e contribuire al successo di Doctolib in Italia.


COSA CI ASPETTIAMO DA TE

Prima di continuare a leggere, se il profilo descritto non è perfettamente aderente al tuo attuale profilo professionale, ma ritieni che questa descrizione corrisponda alle tue capacità e alle tue esigenze, ti invitiamo a proseguire!

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Retrieval (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
SET A NEW PULSE FOR HEALTHCARE!

We are looking for a Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Retrieval to join our AI team working on Clinical decision support and Medical Knowledge.

Your mission will be to ground clinical AI decisions in validated, trusted medical sources from HAS guidelines and learned society recommendations to peer-reviewed clinical studies. You will work in a feature team developing Doctolib's Medical Knowledge Platform, contributing directly to the reliability and safety of AI-powered healthcare experiences used by hundreds of thousands of health professionals and millions of patients across Europe.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.


 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

 - Build and own Doctolib's Medical Knowledge Platform, designing the systems that ground clinical AI decisions in validated medical sources (HAS guidelines, learned society recommendations, clinical studies)

 - Design and maintain both indexing pipelines and retrieval systems, ensuring end-to-end ownership across the full retrieval stack

 - Operate at scale: architect and optimize systems handling 100M+ documents, 50+ req/s, and sub-300ms latency requirements

 - Build custom re-rankers, optimize query processing pipelines, and design robust retrieval evaluation frameworks

 - Engineer deep RAG systems from the ground up - going well beyond off-the-shelf components to tackle real medical knowledge complexity

 - Work across the full retrieval stack: vector embeddings, vector search, re-ranking, query expansion and rewriting
jobs.requirements_raw:
WHO YOU ARE

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

 - Have proven production experience building and scaling search & retrieval systems in a real-world, high-traffic environment 

 - Bring deep dual expertise in both offline indexing and online retrieval; you own the full pipeline, not just one side of it.

 - Are genuinely hands-on with the retrieval tech stack: Elasticsearch, Solr, Vertex AI, vector search, embeddings, re-ranking and query processing.

 - Have gone beyond commodity RAG; you've built custom re-rankers, optimized indexing pipelines, or engineered query processing solutions that required real technical depth.

 - Have operated at Senior or Staff level, with the autonomy and technical depth that comes with it.

 

It would be fantastic if you:

 - Have experience working with medical knowledge sources, clinical databases, or healthcare information systems

 - Have contributed to evaluation frameworks and benchmarks for retrieval quality or AI outputs in regulated or high-stakes environments

 - Have worked in a multi-lingual retrieval context or with domain-specific ontologies


 


LIFE AT DOCTOLIB TECH

 - Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

 - Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

 - We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here https://careers.doctolib.com/ai-careers/.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site https://careers.doctolib.com/tech-doctolib/.


 


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

 - 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

 - Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

 - Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

 - Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

 - A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

 - 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

 - ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

 - Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

 - For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

 - Relocation support in case of international mobility

 - Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training


 


OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Recruiter Screen (45')

 - Live Coding Interview (75')

 - System Design Interview (75')

 - Behavioural Interview (75')

 - Reference Check & Offer

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page https://careers.doctolib.com/tech-doctolib/getting-hired/.


 


JOB DETAILS

 - Permanent position

 - Tech stack: Python, Elasticsearch, Solr, Vertex AI, vector search, embeddings

 - Full-time

 - Levallois-Perret, France

 - Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)

 - Start date: as soon as possible


 


WE WELCOME EVERYONE

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!


 


YOUR DATA PRIVACY

All information provided is processed by Doctolib for application management. For data processing details, click ici https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-FR. Please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com for inquiries or to exercise your rights.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Database (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
Join a team of passionate and hardworking entrepreneurs to transform healthcare! 

Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with engineering, design, and business teams.

Doctolib is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to keep Doctolib production database systems running smoothly. You will also be a key-player to support the exponential growth of Doctolib services.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

You will join a team of developers, DBA and SRE responsible for:

 - Improving and protecting the health of our datastores,

 - Empowering the whole tech teams to use our datastores in the most efficient way,

 - Collaborating everyday with our Database Architects, Principal Engineers and Site Reliability Engineers from other teams.

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer in our Doctolib Database Optimization team, you will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, availability, and performance of our databases. You will:

Design, build and maintain core infrastructure databases that allow Doctolib scaling to support hundreds of thousands of concurrent users.

 - Automate deployment, scaling, and maintenance of databases to enhance system reliability and operational efficiency,

 - Implement and improve monitoring, alerting, and incident response processes to identify and address potential issues before they impact both practitioners and patients,

 - Provide documentation and tooling to empower the feature teams in their use of their databases, while ensuring their reliability,

 - Mitigate production database issues during working hours when the issue cannot be fixed by the responsible feature team,

 - Research and evaluate new technologies, tools, and best practices to continuously improve the reliability and availability of our systems and processes.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer (x/f/m) - Phone Assistant
jobs.description:
WHAT WE DO


Join a team of passionate and hardworking entrepreneurs to transform healthcare!



Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with product, design, and business teams.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer (Python) to join the Conversational AI (CAI) team in the Practice Efficiency domain.



As a Senior AI Engineer, your mission will be to build and scale a new product in the Doctolib suite: our Phone Assistant, with the vision to revolutionize access to care for patients and day-to-day practice management for practitioners. This opportunity will allow you to leverage the latest technologies in AI, NLP, and speech recognition to build delightful user experiences and scale your product to millions of users.



Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

 

 - Design, ship, and operate production-grade agentic LLM systems that improve patient-practitioner interaction and streamline healthcare workflows

 - Validate hypothesis with offline evaluation datasets and A/B tests on real traffic

 - Partner with other machine learning teams to design and improve evaluation pipelines, security/safety guardrails, and metrics

 - Develop and maintain core agentic capabilities, including memory, reasoning orchestration, and tool adapters, ensuring strong observability, fallback mechanisms, and fail-safe behaviors

 - Own performance, observability, and security: monitoring dashboards, SLO/SLI, security posture

 - Ensure privacy and security by design

 - Contribute to cross-functional initiatives that shape Doctolib's future AI platform and best practices in building agentic systems that will reinvent the work of health professionals and improve people's health


ABOUT OUR TECH ENVIRONMENT

 - Our solutions are built on a single, fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to the country and healthcare specialty requirements. To address these challenges, we are modularizing our platform run in a distributed architecture through reusable components.

 - Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

 - We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here https://careers.doctolib.com/ai-careers/!

 - We also invest in open, applied AI research. For example, our DoctoBERT project introduces open-source medical language models trained for French clinical text, with applications in named entity recognition, classification, and retrieval. Read the DoctoBERT practical guide https://huggingface.co/blog/hugging-science/doctobert-cookbook#introduction to learn more about how we bring deep AI research into practical healthcare applications.

Vous intégrerez une Business Unit dynamique pilotée par le Directeur Hôpitaux et Groupes, composée de plusieurs Sales pilotés par un Senior Manager qui assurera votre encadrement direct. Soudés par un fort esprit d'équipe, nous avons pour ambition de faire de Doctolib le partenaire privilégié des hôpitaux français pour les services digitaux aux professionnels de santé et aux patients.

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

 - Augmenter le nombre d'établissements hospitaliers utilisateurs de Doctolib Hôpital : gestion de cycles de vente complexes (prospection à froid, rendez-vous de direction sur site avec DG, DSI, Président de CME), réponse aux appels d'offres, animation du plan marketing dédié au secteur hospitalier

 - Cadrer les projets Doctolib Hôpital selon les spécificités (réglementaires, organisationnelles, techniques) de chaque établissement : conseil en stratégie digitale auprès des établissements hospitaliers et leur direction, développement de partenariats stratégiques avec les éditeurs de Systèmes d'Information Hospitalier

LES QUALITÉS ATTENDUES EN TANT QUE SENIOR SALES CENTRES HOSPITALIERS

 - Avez une expérience significative dans le secteur de la santé : e-santé, éditeur de logiciels médicaux, solutions pour établissements hospitaliers, logiciels SaaS dans le domaine médical

 - Faites preuve d'organisation, de structure et maitrisez les méthodologies de vente structurées type MEDDIC

 - Vous avez une appétence et une connaissance de l'intelligence artificielle et de ses applications dans le domaine de la santé

 - Êtes polyvalent, capable de gérer plusieurs projets en même temps

Ce serait fantastique si :

 - Vous maîtrisez les politiques et initiatives nationales portées par le Ministère, les agences régionales de santé et la FHF

 - Vous souhaitez faire partie d'une expérience unique et collective pour transformer le système de santé en France


NOTRE OFFRE

LE PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT

jobs.title: Head of Design System (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
SET A NEW PULSE FOR HEALTHCARE!

We are looking for a Head of Design Systems to join the Brand and Design team at Doctolib.

Your mission will be to ensure every Doctolib product surface is built on a consistent, high-quality design foundation. You will own Oxygen, Doctolib's design system - much more than a component library. Oxygen is how we deliver our brand identity consistently throughout the product and the critical infrastructure that ensures design quality at scale across an AI-first development environment. With over 50 designers and engineers building across multiple markets and product surfaces, your work will directly shape the experience of more than 90 million patients and 400,000 healthcare professionals.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

 - Set the multi-year vision and roadmap for Oxygen, connecting the dots across engineering, design, and brand teams. Translate system health into business impact and own the investment strategy for the teams, tools, and governance that support it.

 - Establish cross-functional governance across Design, Product, Engineering, and Brand teams, defining contribution models, change management processes, and the standards other teams are expected to follow.

 - Own design output quality across the product, ensuring that AI-generated interfaces are coherent, consistent, and on-brand at every touchpoint across the company.

 - Define and drive cross-organizational adoption, measuring adoption rate, component coverage, and contribution velocity, and connecting those metrics to product team speed and quality.

 - Manage and grow a team of design system designers and engineers, setting career paths, a high bar for craft, and hiring for the roles the system needs next.
jobs.requirements_raw:
WHO YOU ARE

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

 - Have 10+ years of experience in product design or design systems, with a proven track record of scaling a mature, complex system across multiple product teams or lines of business

 - Bring engineering fluency: you understand the technical architecture of a design system, how platform teams operate, and the latest best practices in AI-first software engineering as it relates to design systems

 - Have demonstrated senior stakeholder management skills, with the ability to negotiate priorities with leadership at Director level and above across large, distributed organizations, and drive change management at scale

 - Take a data-informed and outcome-oriented approach: you measure system health in real metrics (adoption rate, handoff defect rate, contribution velocity) and connect those numbers to product quality and business outcomes

 - Have experience in a regulated, enterprise, or healthcare-adjacent context where accessibility (WCAG), localization (i18n, RTL), and multi-market constraints are critical to design systems

 - Are fluent in English

 

It would be fantastic if you:

 - Have experience owning large-scale change management programs across cross-functional organizations

 - Speak additional European languages, such as French, German, or Italian


LIFE AT DOCTOLIB TECH

 - Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

 - Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

 - We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here https://careers.doctolib.com/ai-careers/.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site https://careers.doctolib.com/tech-doctolib/.

 


WHAT WE OFFER

 - A Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass) fully paid for by Doctolib

 - 28 vacation days + 1 additional day for each full calendar year of employment (up to a maximum of 30 days)

 - Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

 - Company health insurance with great supplementary benefits through our partner Allianz

 - Company pension scheme (bAV) through Allianz with an employer subsidy of 40% (15% within the probationary period)

 - The Doctolib Parent Care program, which includes one month additional parental leave and much more

 - Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

 - Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

 - Subsidized sports membership through our partner Urban Sports Club

 - A flexible workplace policy offering both hybrid and office-based mode

 - Alongside healthy snacks and our regular breakfast buffet, we provide a subsidized meal benefit

 - For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

 - Relocation support in case of international mobility

 - Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training


OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Recruiter Interview

 - Portfolio Review

 - Design System Live Case

 - Behavioral Interview

 - At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page https://careers.doctolib.com/tech-doctolib/getting-hired/.

 


JOB DETAILS

 - Permanent position

 - Full-time

 - Paris or Berlin

 - Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)

 - Start date: as soon as possible


WE WELCOME EVERYONE

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

jobs.title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Clinical - AI Teams (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO

We are looking for a Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer to join the Clinical team in the AI and Machine Learning Department. You'll lead the technical direction of AI systems that enhance clinical decision-making and patient care. You'll tackle the hardest problems in healthcare AI, from building voice-powered consultation assistants to establishing LLM evaluation frameworks that ensure clinical safety and efficacy. This role combines deep R&D with strategic technical leadership, shaping how Doctolib deploys AI in regulated healthcare environments.

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Technical Strategy & Architecture

 - Own the long-term technical roadmap for clinical ML systems, from model architecture selection to production deployment patterns

 - Drive strategic build vs. buy decisions, balancing custom development with foundation model APIs

 - Define standards for safe rollout in healthcare contexts: shadow testing, staged deployment, and human-in-the-loop workflows

End-to-End ML Delivery

 - Lead design and implementation of LLM-powered clinical agents (consultation summarization, clinical coding, evidence-grounded recommendations)

 - Establish rigorous evaluation frameworks using real-world clinical datasets, ensuring outputs meet clinical accuracy and safety standards

 - Build production infrastructure: model and prompt versioning, guardrails, uncertainty quantification, cost optimization, and observability

 - Define a bold strategy for online and offline performance objectives to reach new levels of healthcare professionals satisfaction

Leadership & Impact

 - Mentor Staff or Senior ML Engineers and Applied Scientists, elevating technical standards across the organization

 - Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning Product, Medical Affairs, Legal, and Compliance teams

 - Translate clinical needs into research questions and production systems that measurably improve patient outcomes

 - Partner with our medical, legal, and compliance teams to meet EU regulatory expectations (e.g., GDPR, MDR, upcoming EU AI Act) and market standards.

 - You have a PhD in Computer Science, AI, Statistics, or related field (or equivalent research experience)

 - You have deep expertise in at least two of: clinical NLP, LLM fine-tuning and evaluation, automatic speech recognition, RAG systems, or reinforcement learning

 - You are expert in Python, PyTorch/Transformers for training, vLLM/similar for inference with a track record deploying ML systems in production (AWS/GCP)

 - You have exceptional communication skills and are able to align diverse stakeholders and explain complex technical decisions

Now it would be fantastic if you have:

 - Gestire domande e obiezioni guidando il prospect verso una decisione rapida

Chiusura e handover:

 - Presentare l’offerta e portare la trattativa fino alla firma, con un ciclo di vendita breve

 - Essere il punto di riferimento del medico durante l'installazione e il training iniziale del prodotto

 - Assicurare un handover puntuale al team di onboarding per un avvio fluido

Pipeline e KPI:

 - Aggiornare il CRM e monitorare KPIs (attività, conversion rate, win rate, tempo medio di chiusura) per migliorare costantemente le performance

Durante tutti gli step di vendita avrai modo di raccogliere feedback sia dai tuoi colleghi che dai clienti. Sarà importante per condividere best practices e suggerimenti per migliorare le attività del team Sales e contribuire al successo di Doctolib in Italia.


COSA CI ASPETTIAMO DA TE

Prima di continuare a leggere, se il profilo descritto non è perfettamente aderente al tuo attuale profilo professionale, ma ritieni che questa descrizione corrisponda alle tue capacità e alle tue esigenze, ti invitiamo a proseguire!

Questo ruolo potrebbe fare per te se: 

 - Hai circa 2-5 anni di esperienza in sales/new business con attività sul field

 - Sei fortemente orientato/a ai risultati: comprendi i KPI e ti impegni a raggiungere e superare gli obiettivi, incentivato/a da un bonus competitivo senza cap

 - Sei proattivo/a e organizzato/a

 - Hai un alto livello di energia e spirito imprenditoriale

 - Sei in possesso di patente di guida e disponibile a spostamenti nella zona assegnata

 - Hai ottime doti di comunicazione interpersonale

Ora, sarebbe fantastico se: 

 - Hai forte interesse o esperienza nel mondo della sanità


COSA OFFRIAMO 

 - Un programma di onboarding dedicato - la Doctolib Sales Academy!

 - Auto aziendale ad uso promiscuo

 - Assicurazione sanitaria integrativa, con la possibilità di includere i familiari conviventi

 - Contributo forfettario mensile per internet e elettricità

 - Food offer: buoni pasto elettronici (8,00€/giorno lavorato)

 - Wellbeing e sport: offriamo servizi per la salute mentale in collaborazione con il nostro partner moka.care e una partnership con Wellhub

 - Un programma di supporto alla genitorialità che include diverse iniziative, tra cui il congedo parentale retribuito al 100%

 - Adesione al piano di incentivi a lungo termine: DoctoGrowth

 - Per chi assiste familiari non autosufficienti e per i lavoratori con disabilità, è previsto un pacchetto che include un adattamento della policy di lavoro da remoto, giorni aggiuntivi di permesso per motivi sanitari e sostegno psicologico

 - Partnership con Ciao Elsa per accesso ai fondi pensione

 - Vaccinazione antinfluenzale offerta ogni anno in inverno e diverse iniziative di prevenzione durante l’anno

 - Supporto alla mobilità internazionale e accesso ai nostri tool e programmi di upskilling

 - Convenzioni aziendali con diversi partner su tutta Italia: Corporate Benefits, Ennevolte, sconti dedicati e promozioni


IL PROCESSO DI SELEZIONE

 - Colloquio con il team di Talent Acquisition

 - Colloquio con l’hiring manager

 - Final Interview

 - Almeno una verifica delle referenze

 - Offerta!


DETTAGLI DELLA POSIZIONE

 - Contratto a tempo indeterminato full-time

 - Area: Verona e Mantova

 - Hybrid work: remoto e sul campo

 - Pacchetto totale: €40.000 - €48.000 annui lordi (incluso bonus legato alla performance)

 - Bonus senza tetto (uncapped) al superamento degli obiettivi

In Doctolib, ci impegniamo a migliorare l'accesso all'assistenza sanitaria per tutte le persone. Questo si riflette nel nostro processo di selezione. Valutiamo i profili esclusivamente in base alle loro qualifiche e alla loro motivazione, senza nessuna forma di discriminazione.

Più si ascolteranno idee diverse, più il nostro prodotto migliorerà veramente l'assistenza sanitaria di ogni utente. Quindi ti diamo il benvenuto e ti invitiamo a candidarti per Doctolib, indipendentemente dal tuo genere, religione, età, orientamento sessuale, etnia o disabilità. Unisciti a noi per costruire un mondo più in salute!

Per garantire pari opportunità, ti invitiamo a escludere informazioni personali (ad esempio foto, età) dalle tue candidature. Se hai bisogno di adattamenti particolari per quanto riguarda il processo di selezione, ti preghiamo di informarci quanto prima.

 Tutte le informazioni fornite vengono trattate da Doctolib per la gestione delle candidature. Per i dettagli sul trattamento dei dati, clicca qui https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-IT. jobs.title: Team Lead Customer Success (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
Werde Teil unserer Mission, werde Teil von Doctolib!

Über eine halbe Million Gesundheitsfachkräfte und Millionen von Patient:innen nutzen Doctolib täglich. Damit unsere Kund:innen den vollen Wert unserer Lösungen ausschöpfen, suchen wir in Berlin eine Führungskraft, die unser Customer Success & Account Management Team für den Bestandskundenbereich leitet – in Vollzeit.

Die Rolle vereint zwei Verantwortungen: Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Bestandskund:innen nach der Implementierung erfolgreich mit Doctolib arbeiten, und Du verantwortest gleichzeitig das Wachstum in diesen Accounts. Dein Team von 6-10 Customer Success Manager:innen und Account Manager:innen trägt ein gemeinsames Retention- und Expansion-Ziel – Du führst es dorthin.


DEINE AUFGABEN

 - Führung und Weiterentwicklung eines Teams von 6-10 Customer Success Manager:innen und Account Manager:innen – von Coaching und Zielsetzung über 1:1s bis zur Rekrutierung neuer Teammitglieder

 - Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer Upsell- und Cross-Sell-Strategie für unser Bestandskundenportfolio – mit klarem Fokus auf langfristigem Kundenerfolg statt kurzfristigem Abschluss

 - Sicherstellung einer exzellenten Kundenbetreuung nach der Implementierung: Dein Team ist erste Anlaufstelle und sorgt für nachhaltige, optimale Nutzung unserer Software

 - Aufbau von Prozessen, die Retention und Wachstum planbar machen: Segmentierung, Health Scoring, Eskalationswege, Übergaben zwischen Sales, Implementation und Support

 - Steuerung anhand relevanter KPIs (u. a. Net Revenue Retention, Churn, Upsell-Umsatz, Aktivierungsgrad) und regelmäßiges Reporting an die Bereichsleitung
jobs.requirements_raw:
DEIN PROFIL

Du bist überzeugt, dass Du das Richtige mitbringst? Dann bewirb Dich – auch wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst. Vielleicht bist Du genau die/der richtige Doctoliber:in für diese oder eine andere Stelle.

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit:

 - Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der disziplinarischen Führung eines Teams im Customer Success, Account Management oder Vertrieb – idealerweise mit Berührungspunkten zu beiden Welten

 - Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit Umsatzverantwortung: Du hast ein Team-Quota oder ein Expansion-Ziel getragen und weißt, wie man es über Pipeline-Steuerung und Forecasting erreicht

 - Eigene Vertriebserfahrung im B2B-Umfeld, bevor Du in die Führung gewechselt bist – Du kannst ein Gespräch selbst führen, nicht nur bewerten

 - Erfahrung darin, Vertriebler:innen oder Success Manager:Innen  zu coachen und weiterzuentwickeln – Onboarding, Gesprächsbegleitung, Performance-Gespräche

 - Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen (z. B. Salesforce) und die Fähigkeit, aus Daten Entscheidungen abzuleiten

 - Verhandlungsgeschick und Überzeugungskraft, auch in schwierigen Kundensituationen und auf Entscheider-Ebene

 - Ausgeprägte kommunikative Fähigkeiten im Umgang mit Kund:innen, angrenzenden Abteilungen und internationalen Teams

 - Fähigkeit, in einem schnell wachsenden Umfeld Prioritäten zu setzen und Dein Team durch Veränderung zu führen

 - Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem:

 - Erfahrung im SaaS-Umfeld, insbesondere mit erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten und wiederkehrenden Umsätzen

 - Kenntnisse des deutschen Gesundheitswesens oder Erfahrung im Vertrieb an Praxen, MVZ oder Kliniken

 - Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Skalierung eines Teams, nicht nur in dessen Steuerung

 - Sicherer Umgang mit Reporting- und Analysetools


WAS WIR DIR BIETEN

 - Ein von Doctolib gesponsertes Deutschlandticket, wenn Du aus dem Büro oder im Hybridmodus arbeitest

 - 28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)

 - Die Möglichkeit, 10 Tag eim Jahr im Ausland zu arbeiten

 - Eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung mit tollen Zusatzleistungen

 - Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 % (15 % während der Probezeit)

 - Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das extra Elternzeit (1 Monat) u.v.m. enthält

 - Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über einen externen Partner 

 - Zusätzlich zu gesunden Snacks und einem regelmäßigen Frühstücksbuffet, bieten wir Essensgutscheine

 - Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

 - Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet

 - Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth


DER INTERVIEW-PROZESS

 1. Kennenlern-Interview mit dem Talent Team

 2. Interview mit Deiner zukünftigen Managerin

 3. Finales Gespräch inkl. Case Study zu Team-Performance und Wachstumsstrategie, inklusive Präsentation

 4. Mindestens eine Referenzprüfung

 
 


JOB DETAILS

 - Festanstellung

 - Vollzeit

 - Arbeitsort: Berlin

 - Startdatum ab sofort

Je diverser unser Team und die Ideen sind, desto mehr wird unser Produkt die Gesundheit unserer Nutzer:innen verbessern können. Deshalb laden wir dich ein, dich bei uns zu bewerben, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Herkunft oder Behinderung. 
Um Chancengleichheit zu gewährleisten, kannst Du in deiner Bewerbung auf Angaben wie Fotos, Alter, etc. verzichten. Lass uns bitte wissen, welche Vorkehrungen wir treffen können, um Dich bestmöglich zu unterstützen. Wir freuen uns, mit Dir das Gesundheitswesen zu digitalisieren!

jobs.title: Sales Manager (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
GROSSER MARKT, PERFEKTES TIMING: DEINE VERANTWORTUNG

Der deutsche Gesundheitsmarkt befindet sich an einem entscheidenden Wendepunkt – und Du digitalisierst ihn, Praxis für Praxis.

Als Account Executive (x/f/m) im Raum Münster & Emsland führst Du Dein Territory wie ein eigenes Business und konzentrierst Dich vollständig auf die Gewinnung neuer Kund:innen. Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben.


DEINE AUFGABEN

 - Outbound und Inbound Sales: Du arbeitest mit einer strukturierten Leadbasis und kontaktierst potenzielle Kund:innen eigenständig telefonisch sowie persönlich vor Ort. Durch aktive Kaltakquise vereinbarst Du erste Termine und entwickelst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten. Gleichzeitig bearbeitest Du eingehende Inbound-Anfragen und führst sie in den Sales-Prozess über.

 - Erste Kontaktaufnahme und Bedarfsermittlung: Du stellst den Erstkontakt her, führst qualifizierte Verkaufsgespräche und verstehst die individuellen Herausforderungen von Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams.

 - Beratender Vertrieb: Du präsentierst unsere KI-gestützte HealthTech-Lösung, entwickelst gemeinsam mit potenziellen Kund:innen passende Lösungen und zeigst den konkreten Mehrwert für ihren Praxisalltag auf.

 - Full-Cycle-Sales: Du verantwortest den gesamten Vertriebsprozess, von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme über die Bedarfsermittlung und Produktpräsentation bis hin zu Verhandlung und Abschluss.

 - Pipeline- und Gebietsverantwortung: Du baust Deine Pipeline eigenständig auf, entwickelst Dein Vertriebsgebiet strategisch und steuerst Deine Aktivitäten datenbasiert über Salesforce.

 - Strukturierte Übergabe nach Vertragsabschluss: Nach dem Abschluss übergibst Du Deine neuen Kund:innen strukturiert an unser Projektmanagement-Team. Dort werden sie anschließend vollständig betreut und bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung begleitet. So kannst Du Dich im Anschluss wieder zu 100 % auf die Gewinnung neuer Kund:innen konzentrieren.

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

 - Sales ist Deine Welt: Du hast mindestens 2-3 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb (idealerweise im Außendienst und B2B-Bereich)

 - Proaktivität und Akquise-Talent: Du glänzt mit exzellenten Akquise- und Pitching-Skills

 - Energie & Überzeugungskraft: Du hast ein hohes Energielevel, verkaufst mit Leidenschaft und überzeugst mit Deinem sicheren und professionellen Auftreten

 - Entrepreneurial Mindset: Du bist ergebnisorientiert, hast ein hohes Organisationsgeschick und behältst auch bei Herausforderungen den Fokus

 - Kommunikation auf Top-Niveau: Du kannst Dich sehr gut mündlich und schriftlich auf Deutsch (C1-Niveau oder höher) ausdrücken

 - Internationale Kompetenz: Für unsere internen Trainings, All-Hands und den Austausch mit internationalen Kolleginnen und Kollegen ist es hilfreich, wenn du Englisch gut verstehen kannst. Falls du dich sprachlich noch weiterentwickeln möchtest, unterstützen wir dich gerne mit entsprechenden Lernangeboten. Perfektes Englisch ist keine Voraussetzung. Deine Kundentermine finden auf Deutsch statt.

 - Regionale Verwurzelung: Du bist in der Region Münster oder Emsland ansässig – das ist die Grundlage für nachhaltigen Erfolg in einem Außendienstterritorium mit hohem Reiseanteil

 - Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

 - Einen Firmenwagen – auch privat nutzbar, versteuert nach der 1 %-Regelung

 - Eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Zusatzleistungen (u.a. Zahnreinigung u.v.m.)

 - Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das 1 Monat extra Elternzeit u.v.m. enthält

 - Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über unseren externen Partner moka.care http://moka.care/

 - Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet

Bei Doctolib verkaufst Du nicht einfach ein Produkt – Du veränderst, wie Gesundheitsversorgung funktioniert. Bereit, Teil davon zu sein? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt und werde Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte! Weitere Informationen zum Arbeitsalltag im Sales bei Doctolib findest Du hier https://careers.doctolib.de/sales/.


DER INTERVIEW-PROZESS

 1. Interview mit unserem Talent Team (remote - 35')

 2. Interview mit der/dem Regional Manager:in (Teamlead) (remote - 60')

 3. DoctoDay: Verbringe einige Stunden mit Deinem zukünftigen Team und erhalte einen ersten Einblick in den Job als Account Executive

 4. Mindestens eine Referenzprüfung


JOB DETAILS

 - Festanstellung

 - Vollzeit

 - Region: Raum Münster & Emsland, mit Office in Düsseldorf

 - Startdatum: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt

Unsere Philosophie

Wir verfolgen die Vision, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Dies spiegelt sich auch im Recruiting wider. Wir evaluieren Bewerbungen ausschließlich auf der Grundlage von Qualifikation und Motivation. Diskriminierung wird bei uns nicht toleriert.

Je diverser unser Team und die Ideen sind, desto mehr wird unser Produkt die Gesundheit unserer Nutzer:innen verbessern können. Deshalb laden wir dich ein, dich bei uns zu bewerben, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Herkunft oder Behinderung.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

We are looking for a Staff Mobile Engineer with strong expertise in React Native to join our Patient domain at Doctolib.

As a Mobile Staff Engineer, your mission will be to work on transforming the Doctolib mobile app into a full health companion powered by AI to help people lead healthier lives. You will play a key role in improving the quality, UX, and depth of our mobile application while contributing significantly to the technical foundations of mobile development for the team.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with product, design, and business teams.

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

 - Establish and evolve mobile architecture patterns and technical standards for the patient domain

 - Drive technical excellence across mobile development, ensuring high code quality and best practices

 - Contribute to the technical roadmap and guide architectural decisions for the mobile platform

 - Mentor and support mobile engineers in implementing robust, scalable solutions

 - Lead by example in building features that enhance the user experience and app performance


ABOUT OUR TECH ENVIRONMENT

 - Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to the country and healthcare specialty requirements. To address these challenges, we are modularizing our platform run in a distributed architecture through reusable components.

 - Our mobile applications are built with React Native. The rest of our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python and Kotlin.

jobs.title: Senior AI Specialist (Operations) (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
Doctolib is looking for you to join us as a Senior AI Specialist (x/f/m) at our Berlin location, starting as soon as possible.

Doctolib is becoming an AI-native company. We are redesigning the way we work, workflow by workflow, and are looking for people who will not only support this transformation, but actively build it. As a Senior AI Specialist, you will be the technical builder and AI Ops Owner behind AI-powered productivity for our Operations and Customer Success teams.

 

You will work in founder and product mode: you will own a workflow end to end, from context and agent design to evaluation, and continuously take it to a higher level of automation. Our ambition is to move away from manual case-by-case work towards workflows that run largely autonomously while maintaining a high quality bar. In this way, you will contribute directly to our mission of improving healthcare for everyone.


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Redesign workflows rather than simply automating them: You analyze the most critical Operations and Customer Success workflows, break down time-consuming processes that require limited judgment, and transform them through the use of AI agents. You set clear objectives for autonomy and quality, and continuously develop them further.

 - Build and operate AI agents as products: You develop and manage agents on platforms such as Dust or Claude. Each agent is deployed to production with a defined baseline and relevant metrics such as benefit, usage, and scalability.

 - Knowledge and context management: You deliberately curate the context agents need, from templates to core data. The guiding principle is quality over quantity. You ensure that knowledge sources in Confluence, Drive, or Salesforce are always up to date and well structured.

 - Evaluation and quality assurance: You define quality standards and establish evaluation routines to identify and address weaknesses such as hallucinations or prompt drift at an early stage. You continuously optimize prompts through systematic user feedback and A/B testing.

 - CRM and data integration: You own the interfaces between CRM systems such as Salesforce and our AI platforms. You automate data flows and work closely with IT to unlock new, valuable data sources for our agents.

 - Central interface and enablement: You translate business requirements into technical solutions and bring together stakeholders from Leadership, IT, and Product. You strengthen the team’s AI fluency in the areas of context, agent management, and evaluation.

 - Impact and measurement: Rather than inventing new KPIs, you make the success of AI measurable using existing metrics such as time, quality, and cost, and use these insights to guide the next steps in scaling.
jobs.requirements_raw:
YOUR PROFILE

Since production-ready AI workflows and agent technologies are still relatively new, years of market experience are rare. We therefore deliberately prioritize potential over years of experience alone. What matters to us is your ability to learn quickly, your strong product mindset, and your judgment. If you are passionate about this field and bring the necessary skills, we would be delighted to hear from you, even if your profile does not perfectly cover every single aspect.


WHAT REALLY MATTERS TO US, REGARDLESS OF THE SPECIFIC TOOL:

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Node.js/TypeScript (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
SET A NEW PULSE FOR HEALTHCARE!

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the DIAL team in the Phone Assistant domain.

Your mission will be to design, build, and scale the AI-powered features that transform how practitioners and patients connect over the phone — making care more accessible for patients and reducing administrative burden for health professionals. You will work in a feature team developing the Phone Assistant, Doctolib's solution that combines LLM reasoning, speech recognition, and real-time backend systems, launching first in Germany and expanding to France and Italy. 

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

 - Build and operate backend services in Node.js/TypeScript (with Python exposure), designing for reliability, scalability, and real-time performance

 - Design, evaluate, and ship LLM-based features end-to-end: prompt engineering, tool calling, structured outputs, guardrails, and fallback strategies

 - Own AI feature quality: build evaluation datasets and scorers (e.g., in Braintrust), track regressions, and make evidence-based ship decisions before each release

 - Deploy and operate cloud-native services on Kubernetes across major cloud providers (AWS/Azure/GCP), and evolve CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions

 - Design data models and drive database migrations and performance tuning for real-time workloads (PostgreSQL: connection pooling, indexing, query optimisation)

 - Maintain a high testing bar (unit, integration, e2e), debug distributed systems in production with strong observability, and contribute to pragmatic, secure architecture decisions

jobs.title: Corporate Development Lead (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
SET A NEW PULSE FOR HEALTHCARE!

We are looking for a Corporate Development Lead to join the Corporate Development  team in Paris.

As a Corporate Development Lead, your mission will be to drive Doctolib's strategy by owning M&A and Investor Relations processes end-to-end: from origination and due diligence through valuation, execution, and strategic recommendations. You will be a key member of a lean, high-impact team sitting at the intersection of corporate finance, strategy, and Investor Relations.

This role offers something rare: direct and early access to Doctolib's top leadership and decision-making. You will be exposed to strategic information and decisions, contribute to deals that shape the company's trajectory, and build deep corporate finance expertise that few roles in the market can offer. As Doctolib's M&A activity grows (both in volume and deal size), the scope and significance of your work will grow with it.

Working closely with Product and Technology leadership, Legal, Finance, target founders, and advisors, you will play a critical role in shaping how Doctolib grows externally through acquisitions that accelerate our product, technology, and healthcare mission across Europe and beyond.

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

 - Own significant M&A workstreams end-to-end, from initial screening and due diligence through valuation, business planning, memo drafting, and execution support

 - Run full target valuations autonomously, including DCF, trading comps, transaction comps, and business plan analysis

 - Own origination streams, including pipeline management, inbound monitoring, market mapping, and market intelligence

 - Contribute to Investor Relations and corporate strategy workstreams, preparing analyses, materials, and executive-level recommendations

 - Write clear strategic and investment memos for senior leadership, steering committees, and board-level audiences, turning complex analyses into actionable recommendations

 - Transfer knowledge to interns and junior team members, while improving the team's AI-enabled ways of working

jobs.title: Workday Integration & Analytics Engineer - Paris (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
Doctolib is looking for a Workday Integration & Analytics Engineer to join its People Systems & Performance (PSP) team. You will own the data and integration layer of Doctolib's HR tech stack and reporting capabilities in Workday. You will design and maintain integrations across all HR systems, and drive the team's upskilling on integration competencies. 

Reporting to the HRIS Tech Lead, you will work in close partnership with People Strategy, Finance, Social Impact, Hiring, Onboarding teams, and the Doctolib Data team. You will play a key role in making HR data actionable for decision-making, while ensuring seamless data flows across platforms including Workday, Payroll tools (ADP), other HR and IT integrations, and future solutions.

This role goes beyond traditional WD reporting and integration. You will be the integration architect for the HR ecosystem — designing connectors, APIs, and data pipelines, collaborating with the Data team and other IT teams, exploring AI-powered automation (DUST our main internal IA platform, Workday AI Agents, MCP, WD Extend), and mentoring the team on integration best practices.

You own also fully one functional scope of a Workday module (between Compensation & Advanced Compensation, or Absence, Time Tracking), performing configuration and unit testing (autonomously for basic configuration, relying on external integrator for complexes ones), assessing impacts and being responsible of alignment with business stakeholders.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Workday Analytics & Reporting

 - Own the full Workday reporting layer: standard reports, custom reports, calculated fields, dashboards, and advanced analytics

 - Build and maintain People analytics capabilities and deliver complex reportings for strategic decisions (ex. of KPIs headcount, attrition, performance trends, compensation benchmarks)

 - Ensure data quality and governance across Workday reports in alignment with HR data standards

Integration Architecture & Engineering

 - Design, build, and maintain all integrations between Workday and the HR ecosystem (ADP Decidium, ADP Celergo, Ashby, Sana, PeopleDoc, Peakon, and future platforms) and also key point of contact for integration with non HR tools

 - Own the integration architecture: APIs, middleware connectors, Workday Studio, Cloud Connect, and Boomi in collaboration with the Delivery Factory

 - Ensure integration monitoring, incident management, and quality standards across the data layer

 - Key contributor to the PeopleData Hub architecture — coordinating closely with business stakeholders and the Doctolib Data team — to design the central data flow layer connecting HR systems to downstream consumers (Finance, BI, Payroll)

AI & Automation (Workday AI Agents, DUST/MCP)

 - Explore and prototype Workday AI Agents capabilities for HR process automation (self-service, proactive insights, L1 deflection , extension with WD Extend capabilities)

 - Contribute to the Workday-MCP use case  — APIs are available, use cases to define

 - Collaborate on DUST integration with Workday to enable AI-powered HR self-service

 - Evaluate build vs. buy vs. integrate on AI tooling for the HR stack

Team Upskilling & Knowledge Sharing

 - Elevate the team's integration capabilities through documentation, hands-on workshops, and shared architecture standards

 - Build runbooks and integration playbooks that enable autonomous operation and handover to operational teams

 - Act as the go-to expert on integration patterns within PSP

jobs.description:

Doctolib è alla ricerca di un/una Field Sales Partner per unirsi al team e sviluppare le attività commerciali a Roma.

 - Essere il punto di riferimento del medico durante l'installazione e il training iniziale del prodotto

 - Assicurare un handover puntuale al team di onboarding per un avvio fluido

Pipeline e KPI:

 - Hai ottime doti di comunicazione interpersonale

 - Hai esperienza o forte interesse per il mondo della sanità

 - Auto aziendale ad uso promiscuo

YOUR IMPACT

We are looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer to join our SRE team dedicated to platform reliability within Platform Engineering.

Your mission will be to act as a technical leader driving Doctolib's reliability and scalability at a European scale, ensuring our platform remains reliable, debuggable, and resilient across infrastructure, observability, and cross-cutting reliability initiatives. You will play a pivotal role in a team driving reliability standards across 170+ applications, contributing directly to supporting 520,000 health professionals and 90 million patients in their daily healthcare journey.

This role sits at the intersection of infrastructure, developer experience, and product engineering. You'll act as a technical leader and strategic partner to SREs, software engineers, and product teams, guiding decisions, mentoring engineers, and driving cross-cutting initiatives that elevate our operational maturity.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

 - Lead large-scale cross-cutting reliability initiatives across the platform, spanning infrastructure automation, observability, and incident management

 - Identify and drive improvements to incident detection, response, and postmortem analysis capabilities

 - Define and evolve SLOs, error budgets, and alerting standards across multiple product teams

 - Take part in the on-call rotation, and actively contribute to improving our on-call experience by refining alerting, reducing noise, and ensuring actionable telemetry

 - Serve as a mentor and technical coach to senior engineers, helping elevate the craft of reliability engineering across the company

 - Influence strategic decisions by providing technical guidance to leadership and representing reliability engineering in architectural reviews and platform discussions

 - Partner with software engineering teams to embed reliability practices early in the development lifecycle

 - Komplexe Fälle meistern: Du übernimmst die technisch anspruchsvollsten Datenmigrations- und Onboarding-Fälle, inklusive komplexer Systemkonfigurationen, API-Anbindungen und Sonderfälle, die andere an Dich eskalieren.

 - Wissen multiplizieren: Du coachst und mentorst Kolleg:innen, teilst Dein Know-how proaktiv und hebst so das technische Niveau des gesamten Teams.

jobs.title: Real-Time Analyst (x/f/m) - Nantes
jobs.description:
VOS MISSIONS

Au sein de l'organisation WFM de Doctolib, le/la Real-Time Analyst (RTA) joue un rôle central dans le pilotage opérationnel de nos centres de contacts multi-canaux (appels et tickets) et multi-sites. Garant(e) du plan de charge au quotidien, vous assurez la cohérence entre les prévisions construites par les planificateurs WFM et la réalité opérationnelle, minute par minute. Interlocuteur(trice) clé entre les équipes terrain et la direction WFM, vous veillez en permanence au maintien des niveaux de service et à la qualité de l'expérience délivrée aux professionnels de santé et aux patients.

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

 - Surveiller en temps réel les volumes traités vs prévisions par canal (appels, tickets) et détecter immédiatement les dérives : surcharge, file d'attente critique, sous-charge

 - Monitorer les KPIs clés — SLA, ASA, taux de décroché, effectif disponible vs prévu — et activer les plans de contingence en cas d'imprévus (absentéisme soudain, pics non anticipés, incidents techniques)

 - Garantir l'adhérence au planning des conseillers, signaler les écarts aux superviseurs et agir pour rétablir l'alignement

 - Orchestrer le reroutage d'activité entre flux chaud et flux froid en cas de déséquilibre, en coordonnant les transferts de compétences et les ressources disponibles sur l'ensemble des sites

 - Documenter les incidents, leurs causes et les actions correctives prises, et alimenter les planificateurs WFM avec des données terrain fiables (absentéisme réel, comportements vs modèles, patterns récurrents)

 - Participer aux revues hebdomadaires WFM pour aligner les observations en temps réel avec la stratégie de planification



LES QUALITÉS ATTENDUES EN TANT QUE REAL-TIME ANALYST (RTA)

Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos aspirations, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.



Vous pourrez être le prochain membre de notre équipe si vous :

 - Justifiez de 2 à 3 ans d'expérience minimum en tant que RTA, Analyste WFM ou dans un rôle similaire de pilotage en temps réel en centre de contacts

 - Maîtrisez un ou plusieurs outils WFM ainsi qu'Excel / Google Sheets pour l'analyse de données et la construction de tableaux de bord opérationnels

 - Connaissez les métriques centres de contacts (SLA, AHT, ASA, taux d'occupation, adhérence) et les modèles de dimensionnement de type Erlang C

 - Faites preuve de réactivité et de sang-froid, avec une capacité à prendre des décisions rapides sous pression, tout en maintenant une rigueur analytique dans la lecture des données

 - Communiquez avec clarté et assertivité, en sachant maintenir la cohérence du plan face aux demandes opérationnelles et transmettre les bons messages aux bons interlocuteurs

Ce serait fantastique si :

 - Vous avez une expérience en environnement multi-canaux (voix + digital) et multi-sites

 - Vous avez une bonne connaissance des enjeux de planification WFM (prévisions, dimensionnement, shrinkage)

 - Vous maîtrisez des outils de reporting en temps réel et êtes à l'aise avec la construction de tableaux de bord de pilotage


NOTRE OFFRE

 - Une mutuelle avantageuse prise en charge à 100 % par Doctolib (régime de base) pour les employés et leurs enfants

 - 25 jours de congés payés

 - Un programme de santé mentale et de coaching personnalisé gratuit avec notre partenaire Moka.care

 - 10 jours par an de télétravail à l'étranger possible

 - Des tickets restaurant d'une valeur de 8,50 € par jour, dont 4,50 € pris en charge par Doctolib

 - Adhésion au plan de partage de la valeur de Doctolib, appelé DoctoGrowth

 - Un programme d'intégration complet de 3 mois incluant la Doctolib Academy et diverses formations (langues, soft skills, compétences techniques)

 - Une subvention du comité d'entreprise pour le remboursement partiel d'adhésions à des activités sportives ou de loisirs

 - Un remboursement à 50 % de l'abonnement aux transports en commun

 - Programme ParentCare : bénéficiez d'un congé de naissance couvert par Doctolib à 100 % le premier mois et à 75 % le deuxième mois

 - Pour les salariés en situation de handicap ou proches aidants, un package comprenant une adaptation du télétravail, des jours d'absence autorisée payés pour les rendez-vous médicaux et un soutien psychologique renforcé

 - Aide au déménagement en cas de mobilité internationale


LE PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT

 - [Entretien avec un recruteur : Un échange pour découvrir votre parcours, vos motivations et évaluer l'adéquation de vos compétences avec nos besoins.]

 - [Rencontre avec nos Managers : Une exploration de vos compétences à travers des mises en situation concrètes et une présentation de notre équipe et mission.]

 - [Échange avec nos Senior Managers : Un approfondissement de votre candidature incluant une simulation de prise de rendez-vous pour vous projeter dans le rôle.]

 - [Prise de référence]


DÉTAILS DU POSTE

 - CDI

 - Temps plein

 - Nantes

 - Prise de poste : dès que possible

 - Hybride (2 jours de télétravail par semaine)

 

Chez Doctolib, nous sommes convaincus que nous devons améliorer la santé pour tout le monde. Cela se reflète dans notre processus de recrutement. Nous évaluons les candidatures uniquement sur la base des qualifications et de la motivation, sans aucune forme de discrimination.

Plus les idées sont diverses, plus notre produit améliorera véritablement la santé pour tout le monde. Vous pouvez postuler chez Doctolib, quel que soit votre genre, religion, âge, orientation sexuelle, origine ethnique ou handicap.

Afin de garantir l'égalité des chances, nous vous invitons à exclure les informations personnelles (par exemple : photos, âge) de vos candidatures. Si vous avez besoin d'aménagements particuliers, merci de nous en informer pour que nous puissions adapter le processus de recrutement. Rejoignez-nous pour construire la santé dont nous rêvons tous !

jobs.description:
VOS MISSIONS

Au sein de l’équipe Hôpital, vous rejoindrez une équipe dynamique qui contribue au développement de l’activité de Doctolib auprès des établissements hospitaliers.

 - Vous participerez à l’identification et à la prospection de nouveaux établissements, ainsi qu’au développement de nouvelles opportunités auprès des établissements déjà clients, notamment autour de nouvelles solutions et fonctionnalités Doctolib.

 - Vous contribuerez également au suivi de la performance et à l’accompagnement des établissements dans l’optimisation de leurs usages, afin d’améliorer leur efficacité opérationnelle et la satisfaction de leurs patients. 

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

 - Participer à l’identification et à la prospection de nouveaux établissements hospitaliers en lien avec les équipes commerciales

 - Contribuer au développement de nouvelles opportunités auprès des établissements déjà clients, notamment autour de nouvelles solutions et fonctionnalités Doctolib

 - Venir en support des responsables de comptes stratégiques dans le pilotage du portefeuille d’établissements hospitaliers

 - Préparer les rendez-vous commerciaux avec les grands comptes hospitaliers en consolidant les informations clés sur les comptes, leurs enjeux et leurs indicateurs de performance

 - Analyser les indicateurs clés de performance des établissements hospitaliers et suivre des plans d’action adaptés pour améliorer leurs résultats

 
 


LES QUALITÉS ATTENDUES

Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos besoins, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.

Vous pourrez être le prochain membre de notre équipe si vous :

 - Êtes étudiant(e) en Master dans une école de commerce et avez une appétence pour le secteur de la santé

 - Avez un intérêt pour le développement commercial, la prospection et la relation client

 - Faites preuve d’un excellent relationnel et savez adapter votre communication à différents interlocuteurs

 - Démontrez des compétences en gestion de projet et savez être organisé(e) et rigoureux(se) dans le suivi de plans d’action

 - Maîtrisez les outils Google Sheets et Excel et êtes orienté(e) résultats

Ce serait fantastique si :

 - Vous avez une première expérience dans le domaine du développement commercial, du Customer Success ou de la gestion de comptes

 - Vous connaissez l’écosystème hospitalier et ses enjeux spécifiques


 


NOTRE OFFRE

 - Un programme d’onboarding complet, avec la Doctolib Academy et de nombreuses sessions de formation au sein de votre équipe (langues, soft skills, compétences techniques)

 - Une carte Swile et de nombreuses offres de restauration au sein de nos locaux 

 - Une offre de sport : un abonnement Urban Sports Club, des cours de sport gratuits dans les bureaux ou à distance

 - Le remboursement des titres de transport à 50%

 - De nombreux bureaux offrant des espaces de collaboration et de bien-être 

 - Une politique de travail flexible avec un mode hybride

 
 


LE PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT

 - Un entretien RH avec Flore, Talent Partner (15 minutes) 

 - Un entretien opérationnel avec un Senior de l'équipe et votre futur·e manager pour approfondir vos motivations et découvrir l'équipe (1 heure) 

 
 


DÉTAILS DU POSTE

 - Stage conventionné à temps plein

 - Durée : 6 mois

 - Début souhaité : janvier 2027

 - Lieu de travail : Levallois-Perret

 - Gratification : Selon le niveau d'études 

 
 

Chez Doctolib, nous sommes convaincus que nous devons améliorer la santé pour tout le monde. Cela se reflète dans notre processus de recrutement. Nous évaluons les candidatures uniquement sur la base des qualifications et de la motivation, sans aucune forme de discrimination.

Plus les idées sont diverses, plus notre produit améliorera véritablement la santé pour tout le monde. Vous pouvez postuler chez Doctolib, quel que soit votre genre, religion, âge, orientation sexuelle, origine ethnique ou handicap.

Afin de garantir l'égalité des chances, nous vous invitons à exclure les informations personnelles (par exemple : photos, âge) de vos candidatures. Si vous avez besoin d'aménagements particuliers, merci de nous en informer pour que nous puissions adapter le processus de recrutement. Rejoignez-nous pour construire la santé dont nous rêvons tous !

Toutes les informations fournies sont traitées par Doctolib pour la gestion des candidatures. Pour plus de détails sur le traitement des données, cliquez ici https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-FR.
