jobs.title: Account Executive SaaS / B2B (x/f/m) – Unterfranken
jobs.description:
Großer Markt, perfektes Timing: Deine Verantwortung

Franken zählt zu den wirtschaftsstärksten Gesundheitsregionen Deutschlands – und zu den Märkten, die Digitalisierung am dringendsten brauchen. Wir bei Doctolib machen diesen Wandel möglich: mit einer KI-gestützten All-in-One-Lösung, die Healthcare Professionals entlastet und Patient:innen bessere Versorgung bringt – Praxis für Praxis.

Als Account Executive SaaS / B2B (x/f/m) führst Du Dein Territory wie ein eigenes Business: von der strategischen Marktbearbeitung bis zum kontinuierlichen Umsatzwachstum. Deine Mission: Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams für Doctolib zu begeistern, nachhaltiges Umsatzwachstum voranzutreiben und Deine Region zu einem der stärksten Märkte Deutschlands zu entwickeln. Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben.

 

Deine Aufgaben

 - Stärke im Neukundengeschäft: Du verstehst, was Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams bewegt – und machst dieses Verständnis zu Deinem stärksten Argument. Du akquirierst zielgerichtet, pitchst mit Überzeugung und bringst Deals konsequent zum Abschluss.

 - Territory Ownership vom ersten Tag an: Du trägst die vollständige Verantwortung für Dein Vertriebsgebiet – von der Marktanalyse über gezielte Akquise bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Du entscheidest, wie Du Deine Energie einsetzt, um maximalen Impact zu erzielen.

 - Nachhaltiges Umsatz- und Pipelinewachstum: Du verantwortest Deinen Erfolg, Deine Pipeline und Dein Netzwerk in der Region – und Du weißt, wie Du alle drei systematisch aufbaust und konsequent entwickelst.

 - Datengetriebene Vertriebssteuerung: Du misst Deine Performance konsequent mit Salesforce, analysierst Deine Kennzahlen, erkennst Muster früh und steuerst gezielt nach.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Dein Profil

Wenn Du nicht jeden der folgenden Punkte erfüllst, aber überzeugt bist, dass diese Stelle zu Dir passt – bewirb Dich. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Perspektive!

 - Nachgewiesene Stärke im Field Sales: Du bringst Vertriebserfahrung im B2B-Außendienst mit – idealerweise im SaaS- und/oder Healthcare-Umfeld. Die Dynamik komplexer Sales-Zyklen ist Dir vertraut; anspruchsvolle Entscheider:innen zu überzeugen ist Deine Stärke.

 - Neukundenakquise mit strategischem Blick: Du liebst es, neue Kund:innen zu gewinnen – und Du gehst dabei nicht nach Bauchgefühl vor. Du analysierst, priorisierst und pitchst mit Präzision.

 - Begeisterung für digitale Transformation im Gesundheitswesen: Du bist davon überzeugt, dass smarte Technologie den Praxisalltag wirklich verbessern kann – und Du machst diese Überzeugung im Gespräch spürbar. Für Ärzt:innen, für Praxisteams, für den Markt.

 - Kommunikation auf Top-Niveau: Du drückst Dich sehr gut mündlich und schriftlich auf Deutsch (C1-Niveau oder höher) aus; Deine Englischkenntnisse sind außerdem mindestens auf Konversationsniveau (B1).

 - Präsenz dort, wo es zählt: Du weißt, dass der größte Impact im direkten Kontakt entsteht – bei Ärzt:innen, in Praxen, vor Ort. Ein Wohnort in der o.a. Region (oder die Bereitschaft, umzuziehen), Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deines Vertriebsgebiets sowie ein Führerschein Klasse B sind daher Voraussetzung.

 

Was wir Dir bieten

 - Die Teilnahme an unserem langfristigen Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

 - Einen Firmenwagen mit Tankkarte – natürlich auch privat nutzbar

 - Erstklassige Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote – maßgeschneidert auf Dich und Deine Karriereziele

 - Eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Leistungen

 - Einen überdurchschnittlichen Arbeitgeberzuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (bAV) von 40 %

 - Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

 - Unser Doctolib Parent Care Programm

 - Individuelle Angebote für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen – darunter flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung

 - Kostenlose und vertrauliche Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über unseren externen Partner

 

So sieht unser Interviewprozess aus

 1. Interview mit Talent Acquisition (Video Call – ca. 45 Minuten)

 2. Interview mit der/dem Regional Manager:in (Video Call – ca. 1 Stunde)

 3. DoctoDay (vor Ort in einem unserer Offices - ca. 1,5 Stunden): verbringe Zeit mit Deinem zukünftigen Team und erhalte einen praxisnahen Einblick in die Aufgaben eines Account Executives bei Doctolib

 4. Eine Referenzprüfung

 5. Unser Angebot an Dich

 

Job Details

 - Unbefristete Festanstellung

 - Vollzeit (40h / Woche)

 - Außendienst in Deinem Vertriebsgebiet

 - Startdatum: so schnell wie möglich

Vous êtes passionné(e) par les réseaux sociaux et vous souhaitez rejoindre une entreprise engagée dans le domaine de la santé ? Rejoignez l'équipe Marketing Patient de Doctolib en tant que Social Media Manager B2C.

 - Modération des communautés : vous serez en charge de gérer les interactions sur nos différents canaux (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Youtube, Trustpilot et apps store). Cela inclut la modération des commentaires et messages privés.

 - Reporting des performances : vous aiderez à collecter, analyser et interpréter les données issues de nos campagnes social media pour évaluer leur impact. L’objectif ? Suivre nos KPIs et améliorer constamment nos contenus.

 - Production de contenus : vous participerez à la création de contenus engageants pour nos différents canaux orientés côté patient (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Youtube). Cela inclut :
   
   - Brainstorming créatif autour de nos campagnes et création de visuels, vidéos courtes et publications.
   
   - Collaboration avec les équipes internes (design, communication) et externes (créateurs de contenu).

 


LES QUALITÉS ATTENDUES POUR CE POSTE 

Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos aspirations, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager - Patient Data Collection (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
SET A NEW PULSE FOR HEALTHCARE!

 

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to join the Patient Profile team in the Patient domain.

Your mission will be to make the patient health record complete, accurate and current enough that everything else we build can act on it, the health recommendations, care plans and assistant experiences that help people take their health into their own hands. You will work in a feature team developing the Patient Health Record, health trackers, patient account and online identity, contributing directly to the quality of the medical support we provide to both patients and practitioners. 

A patient record is built from four channels: what patients enter themselves, what they share when preparing a consultation, what we retrieve from health professionals' systems, and what they connect from third-party sources such as Apple Health, Google Health Connect and national health record services. Three of those channels belong to teams you will not manage. You will own the outcome across all four, the most leveraged place to sit in a health platform, and only reachable through other people.

You will also work inside a hard regulatory perimeter: health data, GDPR, consent by design. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

 - Own the end-to-end patient data collection programme across every channel a patient record is built from, and be accountable for the result across all four

 - Define what a useful record actually means for the teams that depend on it, make that definition measurable, and instrument it rather than inheriting a dashboard

 - Partner with the channel-owning teams inside and outside the group: set the inter-team contracts, agree how each channel contributes, and arbitrate collection priorities

 - Own record quality and freshness rather than volume, alongside health data storage consent, patient account and online identity

 - Ship the layers that serve this data to the rest of the product: the patient feature store, the patient context service and the Patient Health Record feature

 - Lead the Patient Profile team's roadmap and delivery, from PHR (patient health record) and trackers through to the feature store and context service

Curioso/a di scoprire com'è la vita da sales in Doctolib? Visita questa pagina https://careers.doctolib.it/vita-da-sales/.

In questo ruolo avrai l'opportunità di acquisire competenze concrete nello sviluppo commerciale. Il tuo obiettivo sarà affiancare il tuo team a trovare e creare nuove opportunità di vendita contattando i centri medici.

Come Business Development Representative Intern, ti occuperai di:

 - Generazione di nuove opportunità di vendita: supportare il team nell’identificare centri medici che potrebbero beneficiare di Doctolib attraverso ricerche di mercato e strumenti digitali come LinkedIn Sales Navigator

 - Contattare i centri medici: farai attività di outbound (incluse cold call ed email) per ingaggiare i contatti giusti, raccogliere informazioni e qualificare i lead

 - Fissare meeting per i colleghi di Inside Sales e Field Sales, condividendo in modo chiaro le informazioni raccolte

 - Utilizzare il CRM (Salesforce) per aggiornare i contatti, tracciare interazioni e monitorare l'avanzamento delle opportunità, sviluppando competenze nella gestione autonoma di una pipeline

 - Supportare il team Sales preparando materiali per le presentazioni e contribuendo a migliorare l’efficacia dei processi e strategie di vendita

Durante tutti gli step avrai modo di raccogliere feedback sia dai tuoi colleghi/e che dai clienti. Sarà importante per condividere best practice e suggerimenti per migliorare le attività del team Sales e contribuire al successo di Doctolib in Italia.

Non sai cosa significa qualche termine sales? Nessun problema! Qui sotto trovi un mini glossario per orientarti:

Outbound: sei tu a contattare per primo/a
Cold call: chiamata a freddo a un contatto che non ti conosce ancora
Lead: potenziale cliente
Qualificare: capire se è in target e vale la pena approfondire
CRM (Customer Relationship Management): strumento per gestire contatti e tracciare chiamate/email
Pipeline: elenco delle opportunità in corso e del loro stato

Prima di continuare a leggere, se il profilo descritto non è perfettamente aderente al tuo attuale profilo professionale ma ritieni che questa descrizione corrisponda alle tue capacità e alle tue esigenze, ti invitiamo a proseguire!

 - Hai voglia di imparare: sei pronto/a a sfruttare le opportunità di formazione continua per sviluppare le tue sales skills e crescere rapidamente

Ora, sarebbe fantastico se:

 - Hai precedente esperienza, anche breve in stage, in ruoli a contatto col cliente

jobs.title: Platform Security Engineer (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
SET A NEW PULSE FOR HEALTHCARE!

We are looking for a Platform Security Engineer to join the Security team at Doctolib.

Your mission will be to protect sensitive healthcare data while enabling rapid, secure innovation. You will be responsible for securing Doctolib's cloud infrastructure and application ecosystem, combining multi-cloud security expertise with hands-on platform engineering — contributing directly to the safety of millions of patients and care teams who rely on our platform every day.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

 - Own a platform security workstream end to end, from architecture to enforcement: scope it with your tech lead, design the control, roll it out progressively (report-only, then enforce), handle exceptions, and see it through to full coverage. Typical examples: hardening IAM across our AWS accounts, tightening cluster admission policies, or closing a class of misconfiguration for good.

 - Ship every change as code: Terraform and GitHub pull requests, peer-reviewed and always reversible. No console clicking, no undocumented state.

 - Harden our cloud and infrastructure baseline and keep it hardened: IAM permissions and access reviews, secrets management, network and cluster guardrails, CI/CD and supply chain controls — building the guardrails and driving remediation of what they surface with platform and engineering teams, turning recurring findings into automation rather than tickets.

 - Investigate and improve: lead incident investigations on the platform perimeter end to end, and continuously improve detection rules and response playbooks in our Elastic SIEM.

 - Work in the open: write clear technical notes, drive adoption of your changes with the engineering teams they affect, and grow through code review and pairing with the rest of the team.
jobs.requirements_raw:
WHO YOU ARE

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

 - Have 1 to 3 years of hands-on experience in security engineering, security operations, SRE, infrastructure or platform engineering, including some exposure to a cloud environment (AWS, GCP or Azure) in production — an internship or apprenticeship in one of those roles counts.

 - Work daily with infrastructure as code and GitHub: you have written and shipped your own Terraform through reviewed pull requests, and you are comfortable operating and debugging workloads on Kubernetes.

 - Use AI coding assistants (Claude or equivalent) as a normal part of how you work.

 - Have carried at least one project through to production — security or not — and stayed with it past the first deployment until it was actually adopted.

 - Have solid fundamentals: Linux, networking, cloud, Kubernetes and development/scripting, a pragmatic mindset, the ability to make decisions under uncertainty and follow through, and strong written communication skills — you can carry a proposal from draft to cross-team adoption.

 - Are fluent in English (working language in writing); daily team conversations happen mostly in French, so being a French speaker or willing to learn is a strong plus.

It would be fantastic if you:

 - Have worked with a SIEM (Elastic, Splunk, or equivalent), writing and tuning your own queries.

 - Have done detection engineering, incident response, threat hunting, or CTFs.

 - Can point to public write-ups, open-source contributions, or a home lab.

 - Have prior experience in a regulated industry (healthcare, fintech, or public sector).

jobs.description:
YOUR IMPACT

We are looking for a Staff DataOps Engineer to join the Data and AI Platform team.

Your mission will be to shape our data platform strategy and architecture, driving enterprise-scale solutions that accelerate machine learning initiatives, enable engineering excellence, and unlock business insights. You will work in a team at the heart of Doctolib's data-driven transformation, enabling innovation through robust, scalable data infrastructure that empowers engineers, AI teams, and business stakeholders across the organization.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.


WHAT YOU'LL BUILD

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

 - Design and implement enterprise-scale data infrastructure strategies, conducting thorough impact and cost analysis for major technical decisions, and establishing architectural standards across the organization

 - Build and optimize complex, multi-region data pipelines handling petabyte-scale datasets, ensuring 99.9% reliability and implementing advanced monitoring and alerting systems

 - Lead cost analysis initiatives, identify optimization opportunities across our data stack, and implement solutions that reduce infrastructure spend while improving performance and reliability

 - Provide technical guidance to data engineers and cross-functional teams, conduct architecture reviews, and drive adoption of best practices in DataOps, security, and governance

 - Evaluate emerging technologies, conduct proof-of-concepts for new data tools and platforms, and lead the technical roadmap for data infrastructure modernization

jobs.description:

En tant que Business Developer, vous serez chargé de prendre contact sur le terrain avec les praticiens de votre zone et leur proposer les solutions Doctolib. Au quotidien, vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Product Led Growth- Nantes (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
SET A NEW PULSE FOR HEALTHCARE!

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Product team at Doctolib.

Your mission: scale Doctolib's acquisition engine into a measurable, lower-cost growth driver across France, Germany and Italy. You will own the end-to-end product-led and marketing-led growth funnel, from freemium offer design to subscription and in-product upsell, contributing directly to growing ARR while bringing the cost to acquire new practitioners down.

Building at Doctolib means shipping products that change how care teams and patients experience healthcare every day.


 



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

 - Own Doctolib freemium offer: define what is free, metered, or demo-only, and design the conversion paths that move practitioners to a paid plan

 - Own and improve the subscription funnel for new business and upsell, across web and in-product surfaces, including checkout and sign-up unification

 - Design and improve every in-product flow that moves an existing customer to a higher-value plan

 - Define acquisition-side packaging: offer catalogue, eligibility rules, and contract signature flows across France, Germany and Italy

 - Lead marketing-led growth initiatives, including lead generation, B2B website conversion, and lifecycle marketing, connecting them to the core product funnel

 - Set the direction for cross-team delivery (along with the PMMs and other counterparts), deciding offer by offer and country by country when conversion is the right path, and when to route a user to sales as a warm, product-qualified lead

 - You read data yourself, define funnel measurement from scratch, and make decisions with experiments rather than opinion

 - You have solid product judgement on pricing, packaging, eligibility and freemium boundaries, and can work within a regulated environment with consent and country-specific constraints in mind

jobs.description:
SET A NEW PULSE FOR HEALTHCARE!

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to join the Scheduling team in Berlin.

Your mission will be to give practitioners their day back:  reclaiming the admin time they spend creating and managing appointments, so care teams can focus on what matters. You will work in a feature team developing scheduling infrastructure and booking experiences, contributing directly to a platform that books billions of appointments a year for health professionals and patients across Europe.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

 - Lead a team of 6 to 7 engineers of mixed seniority, owning delivery, quality and production health end to end — keeping engagement high and standards higher

 - Together with your product partner, define the mission and vision for your team and build a roadmap you can defend to stakeholders

 - Take part in architecture reviews and help shape the technical direction of the Scheduling stream, including the migration of core scheduling capabilities from the monolith into purpose-built services

 - Set and uphold the security, reliability, performance and scalability standards required to remain the most trusted e-health SaaS in Europe

 - Partner with Talent and People teams to recruit, develop and retain engineers through career conversations and feedback they can act on

 - Embed AI-assisted engineering into how your team works day to day, with a clear and honest view of where it helps and where it does not

 - Continuously improve how the team operates — planning, on-call, bug backlog, incident follow-up — so the team spends its energy on what moves the needle

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer - Search & Recommendation - Patient Team (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
JOIN OUR MISSION, JOIN DOCTOLIB! 

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join the Patient team in Paris. 

The Patient domain sits at the heart of Doctolib's mission: ensuring everyone has better access to the care they need, receives better care from health professionals, and can actively prevent health problems to improve their wellbeing.

You’ll design the search and recommendation engines behind our health companion, helping 100M patients across Europe instantly navigate to the exact care they need while delivering trusted, curated insights at every step. The retrieval and recommendation architecture you own will directly shape how relevant, fast, and trustworthy that experience is for every one of them.


Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

 - Design and build the production search & recommendation architecture: full retrieval, ranking, reranking pipeline with standard and off-the-shelf components (vector search, semantic retrieval, LLM/managed rerankers).

 - Establish strong baselines first (prompts, RAG, model selection) before reaching for custom ML.

 - Build evaluation and observability into every stage, with offline and online evaluation.

 - Set up the data/event feedback loops that drive iteration and feed deeper ML later.

 - Improve search relevance and ranking on Patient facing products , raising result quality

 - Own production quality: latency reliability, monitoring, and maintainability.

 - Partner with ML Engineers and collaborate closely with PMs and SWEs to define, build, and ship AI-powered features that deliver measurable value to users and the business.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Observability & Reliability Engineering Obsession (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Engineering Manager to join the OREO (Observability Reliability Engineering Obsession) team in Platform Engineering.

As an Engineering Manager, your mission will be to lead the Reliability & Observability team and drive the evolution of Doctolib's observability platform, supporting the exponential growth of Doctolib services while building and empowering a world-class SRE team.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with product, design, and business teams.

You will lead a team of Site Reliability Engineers who are responsible for shaping Doctolib's observability strategy and ensuring our platform remains reliable, debuggable, and scalable. This role sits at the intersection of people management, technical leadership, and strategic planning with a particular focus on building organizational capabilities around logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.

Your team also owns and operates critical transversal services that enable secure, scalable infrastructure management across the organization, including HashiCorp Vault for secrets management and Terraform Enterprise for infrastructure as code.

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

 

People Leadership:

 - Lead, coach, and grow a team of Site Reliability Engineers, supporting their technical development and career progression

 - Create a culture of operational excellence, continuous improvement, and psychological safety within the team

 - Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations

 - Recruit, onboard, and retain top SRE talent aligned with Doctolib's mission and values

Technical Strategy:

 - Partner with SREs and senior engineers to define and evolve the observability strategy across the platform, focusing on logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting

 - Own the strategy and evolution of critical transversal services including HashiCorp Vault and Terraform Enterprise

 - Drive prioritization and roadmap planning for large-scale reliability and observability initiatives

 - Ensure alignment between team objectives and broader engineering and business goals

 - Advocate for and allocate resources toward reducing technical debt and improving developer experience

Operational Excellence:

 - Own the team's on-call experience and contribute to the incident response processes, ensuring sustainable practices and continuous improvement

 - Ensure high availability and reliability of transversal services that are critical to the entire engineering organization

 - Lead postmortem reviews and drive systemic improvements to prevent recurring issues

Cross-functional Collaboration:

 - Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, and architects to align observability capabilities with product and platform needs

 - Partner with security and infrastructure teams to evolve secrets management and IaC practices across the organization

 - Represent the OREO team in engineering leadership forums, architectural reviews, and strategic planning sessions

 - Foster strong partnerships with software engineering teams to improve instrumentation quality and adoption of observability best practices


ABOUT OUR TECH ENVIRONMENT

 - Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to the country and healthcare specialty requirements. To address these challenges, we are modularizing our platform run in a distributed architecture through reusable components.

 - Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

jobs.title: Stage - FP&A Analyst (x/f/m) - mars 2027
jobs.description:
Vous êtes passionné.e par la finance et vous souhaitez vous imprégner des problématiques financières d’une entreprise de la tech française en pleine croissance ? 

L'équipe FP&A (Financial Planning & Analysis) recherche un·e stagiaire pour un stage de 6 mois afin de contribuer au reporting financier et au support stratégique de Doctolib. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec une équipe de 6 personnes et auras l'opportunité de découvrir l'ensemble des activités de l'équipe.


 


VOS MISSIONS

En tant que FP&A Analyst, vous serez intégré·e à l'équipe FP&A et travaillerez sur des missions diversifiées touchant au pilotage financier de Doctolib.

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

 - Clôtures mensuelles et reporting financier : contribuer aux clôtures comptables mensuelles, préparation du reporting groupe mensuel pour le COMEX et contribution au deck trimestriel à destination du Board

 - Support au pilotage stratégique : assister à la préparation des présentations pour les différents membres du COMEX et assurer le suivi des KPIs opérationnels via nos outils de BI (Tableau et Metabase)

 - Suivi du budget : suivre les hypothèses budgétaires, participer à la construction des forecasts trimestriels et accompagner les équipes opérationnelles 

 - Optimisation des process de reporting (recours à l’IA pour fiabiliser et améliorer nos process)

 - Missions ad-hoc sur divers sujets financiers


 


LES QUALITÉS ATTENDUES POUR CE POSTE

Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos aspirations, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.

Vous pourrez être le prochain membre de notre équipe si vous :

 - êtes étudiant·e en Master 1 ou 2 d’une école de commerce ou équivalent avec une spécialisation en finance/contrôle de gestion, et cherches un stage de césure/ fin d'études

 - êtes reconnu·e pour votre organisation et votre rigueur, tout en sachant être force de proposition

 - aimez et êtes capable de mener plusieurs projets simultanément

 - êtes doté·e d'une excellente communication écrite et orale

 - parlez anglais couramment

Ce serait fantastique si vous :

 - avez une première expérience avec des logiciels ERP/EPM (SAP, Anaplan)

 - avez un intérêt pour l'IA


 


NOTRE OFFRE

 - Un programme d’onboarding complet, avec la Doctolib Academy et de nombreuses sessions de formation au sein de votre équipe

 - Des programmes de formation (langues, soft skills, compétences techniques)

 - Une carte Swile et de nombreuses offres de restauration au sein de nos locaux 

 - Une offre de sport : un abonnement Urban Sports Club, des cours de sport gratuits dans les bureaux ou à distance

 - Le remboursement des titres de transport à 50%

 - De nombreux bureaux offrant des espaces de collaboration et de bien-être 

 - Une politique de travail flexible avec un mode hybride


 


LE PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT

 - Un entretien RH avec Aya, Talent partner (15 minutes) 

 - Un entretien opérationnel d'une heure avec deux membres de l'équipe (1 heure)


 


DÉTAILS DU POSTE

 - Stage conventionné à temps plein

 - Durée : 6 mois

 - Début souhaité : mars 2027

 - Lieu : Levallois-Perret

 - Gratification : À définir selon profil


 

Chez Doctolib, nous sommes convaincus que nous devons améliorer la santé pour tout le monde. Cela se reflète dans notre processus de recrutement. Nous évaluons les candidatures uniquement sur la base des qualifications et de la motivation, sans aucune forme de discrimination.

Plus les idées sont diverses, plus notre produit améliorera véritablement la santé pour tout le monde. Vous pouvez postuler chez Doctolib, quel que soit votre genre, religion, âge, orientation sexuelle, origine ethnique ou handicap.

Afin de garantir l'égalité des chances, nous vous invitons à exclure les informations personnelles (par exemple : photos, âge) de vos candidatures. Si vous avez besoin d'aménagements particuliers, merci de nous en informer pour que nous puissions adapter le processus de recrutement. Rejoignez-nous pour construire la santé dont nous rêvons tous !

Toutes les informations fournies sont traitées par Doctolib pour la gestion des candidatures. Pour plus de détails sur le traitement des données, cliquez ici https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-FR. Veuillez contacter hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com pour toute question ou pour exercer vos droits.

jobs.title: Working Student - IT Asset & Stock Management (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
WORKING STUDENT – IT ASSET & STOCK MANAGEMENT (X/F/M) – BERLIN


JOIN OUR MISSION, JOIN DOCTOLIB!

Doctolib is looking for you as a Working Student in IT Asset & Stock Management to support our IT team at our office in Berlin.

To give the best experience to Doctolibers and support Doctolib’s growth, you will help manage our IT stock and asset base, including laptops, smartphones and accessories. Reporting to the IT team, you will own the reliability of our hardware inventory and contribute to day-to-day on-site support in an international environment across Germany, France, Italy and the Netherlands.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a Working Student, you will support us in the following areas:

IT stock and asset management — approximately 70%

 - Manage the site’s IT stock, including receiving, checking, labelling and storing laptops, smartphones and accessories

 - Keep the inventory up to date in our asset management tool and ensure the accuracy of serial numbers, assignments and statuses

 - Follow the full equipment lifecycle, including assignment, return, loan, vendor repair, refurbishment and recycling

 - Run periodic physical inventories and consistency checks between physical stock and the asset management tool

 - Monitor stock levels, flag replenishment thresholds and contribute to supplier orders

 - Prepare devices, including mobile device management enrolment, standard configuration and accessory kits

 - Propose improvements to stock processes, documentation, automation and key performance indicators

On-site support — approximately 30%

 - Support onboarding and offboarding by preparing, handing over and recovering equipment for joiners and leavers

 - Run the Berlin IT Corner as a physical point of contact for Doctolibers

 - Manage meeting room hardware by testing, updating and replacing equipment

 - Handle level 1 requests and incidents, including basic diagnosis and application access, and escalate to level 2 when needed

 - Identify recurring requests and contribute to continuous improvement


WORKING WITH US, YOU WILL LEARN:

 - How to manage the full lifecycle of IT hardware and maintain reliable asset data

 - How on-site IT support contributes to a smooth employee experience

 - How to identify opportunities to improve operational processes through documentation, automation and performance indicators

jobs.title: Senior Medical Content Manager (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
WERDE TEIL UNSERER MISSION, WERDE TEIL VON DOCTOLIB!

Wir suchen Dich als Senior Medical Content Manager (x/f/m) als Unterstützung für das Patient Content Factory Team in Berlin.

Doctolib ist Europas führender Health Companion und begleitet Millionen von Patient:innen und Gesundheitsfachkräften auf dem gesamten Kontinent. Wir transformieren die Gesundheitsversorgung, indem wir unsere Plattform mit innovativen Lösungen rund um Prävention und Patient:innen-Empowerment bereichern.

Unser nächster Schritt: Doctolib zur vertrauenswürdigsten Gesundheitskontent-Destination in Europa zu machen. Dafür haben wir das Patient Content Factory Team ins Leben gerufen — ein dediziertes Team, das für alle Inhalte innerhalb der Doctolib-App verantwortlich ist. Dies umfasst Präventionskampagnen sowie personalisierte Gesundheitsinformationen (Artikel, Videos, interaktive Inhalte), die auf verifizierten medizinischen Kenntnissen basieren.

Du verantwortlich für das Verfassen und die Verwaltung von Inhalten für den Health Companion der App — und stellst dabei höchste Qualitätsstandards sicher. Du koordinierst funktionsübergreifende Stakeholder, sorgst für End-to-End-Qualität an allen Touchpoints und steuerst die gesamte Content-Produktion.


DEINE AUFGABEN

 - Du hilfst beim Aufbau und der Pflege des Redaktionskalenders für alle deutschen Gesundheitsinhalte und identifizierst Content-Möglichkeiten basierend auf Patient:innen-Bedürfnissen und öffentlichen Gesundheitsprioritäten

 - Du schreibst und erstellst verständliche medizinische Inhalte für Patient:innen und übersetzt komplexe medizinische Informationen in klare, handlungsorientierte Artikel für das deutsche Publikum

 - Du managst den gesamten Content-Workflow von der Idee bis zur Veröffentlichung und koordinierst interne sowie externe Content-Writer:innen für eine termingerechte Umsetzung

 - Du verwaltest Inhalte und Redaktionskalender über ein CMS und treibst die Optimierung von Content-Prozessen durch Automatisierung und KI voran

 - Du sorgst dafür, dass alle Inhalte höchste Standards in Bezug auf Genauigkeit, Klarheit und Healthcare-Compliance erfüllen, und koordinierst strenge Review-Prozesse mit medizinischen Gutachter:innen und Expert:innen

 - Du trägst zum Aufbau eines Netzwerks aus glaubwürdigen Partner:innen (Institutionen, Expert:innen, medizinische Fachgesellschaften) bei, um die Autorität von Doctolibs Gesundheitsinhalten zu stärken

jobs.description:
GEMEINSAM GESTALTEN WIR DIE GESUNDHEITSVERSORGUNG DER ZUKUNFT

Doctolib sucht Dich ab sofort als Praktikant:in im Bereich SDR im Inside Sales für unseren Standort in Berlin.

Du möchtest erste praktische Erfahrungen im Vertrieb sammeln und herausfinden, ob Sales der richtige Karriereweg für Dich ist? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig. Als Teil unseres Inside Sales Teams erhältst Du einen praxisnahen Einblick in den modernen B2B-Vertrieb, arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Sales Development Representatives und Inside Sales Consultants zusammen und übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung. Dabei entwickelst Du wertvolle Sales-Skills, lernst moderne Vertriebsmethoden kennen und trägst dazu bei, die Digitalisierung des Gesundheitswesens voranzutreiben.


DEINE AUFGABEN

Als Praktikant:in unterstützt Du uns dabei in folgenden Aufgabenbereichen: 

 - Du kontaktierst potenzielle Praxen und Gesundheitseinrichtungen telefonisch, per E-Mail und über weitere digitale Kanäle.

 - Du vereinbarst qualifizierte Erstgespräche für unsere Inside Sales Consultants und leistest so einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Ausbau unserer Sales Pipeline.

 - Du planst und dokumentierst Deine Outbound-Aktivitäten in unserem CRM-System.

 - Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen aus dem Inside Sales Team zusammen und erhältst regelmäßiges Coaching und Feedback.

 - Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und unterstützt bei der Optimierung unserer Outbound-Prozesse.


WÄHREND DEINER TÄTIGKEIT BEI UNS WIRST DU LERNEN:

 - Erfolgreiche Outbound-Akquise im B2B-Vertrieb.

 - Professionelle Gesprächsführung mit Entscheider.

 - Den Einsatz moderner Sales-Tools und CRM-Systeme.

 - Wie eine erfolgreiche Sales Pipeline aufgebaut und weiterentwickelt wird.

 - Die Grundlagen für einen erfolgreichen Karrierestart im Tech Sales.

jobs.title: Fullstack Software Engineer - React, Kotlin & Ruby on Rails (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
Join ACAI (Advanced Calendar Improvement), a team dedicated to making day-to-day practice operations more efficient and less mentally exhausting for healthcare professionals and their teams.

Practice operations are often fragmented across post-its, emails, SMS, phone calls, oral instructions, and individual memory. This makes it difficult for teams to know what needs to be done, who owns it, how urgent it is, and what has already happened.

As a Software Engineer, you will help build products that centralise work, improve coordination, and automate administrative tasks across the practice; directly contributing to a smoother experience for healthcare professionals, staff, and patients.


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Develop reliable, intuitive features for Task Manager, Patient Flow Management, patient intake, appointment proposals, and telesecretaryship workflows

 - Help practices coordinate the patient journey from arrival to completion of a visit, including waiting-room status, care steps, walk-ins, delays, patient movement, and check-out

 - Design solutions that reduce the time healthcare professionals and staff spend manually creating, sorting, remembering, relaunching, and completing tasks

 - Work across backend and frontend technologies to deliver high-quality, user-facing experiences

 - Build performant, reliable, and observable services that can support Doctolib's growing user base and complex healthcare workflows

 - Apply strong privacy, data protection, and security practices when working with personal and health-related information

 - Partner closely with Product, Design, Data Protection, and other engineering teams to understand problems and deliver valuable solutions


ABOUT OUR TECH ENVIRONMENT

Our solutions run on a single, fully cloud-native platform serving web and mobile applications across multiple languages and countries, each with its own regulatory and specialty-specific requirements. 

To address these challenges, we are modularising our platform through reusable components and a distributed architecture. 

On ACAI, you'll primarily work with Ruby and Kotlin on the backend and React with TypeScript and Rails on the frontend. Doctolib's broader technology environment also includes Java, Python and Swift.

We leverage AI in an ethical manner across our products to empower patients and healthcare professionals. Discover our AI vision https://careers.doctolib.com/ai-careers/.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer - Patient Team (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
JOIN OUR MISSION, JOIN DOCTOLIB! 

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join the Patient team in Paris. 

The Patient domain sits at the heart of Doctolib's mission: ensuring everyone has better access to the care they need, receives better care from health professionals, and can actively prevent health problems to improve their wellbeing.

You’ll design the search and recommendation engines behind our health companion, helping 100M patients across Europe instantly navigate to the exact care they need while delivering trusted, curated insights at every step. The retrieval and recommendation architecture you own will directly shape how relevant, fast, and trustworthy that experience is for every one of them.


Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

 - Design and build the production search & recommendation architecture: full retrieval, ranking, reranking pipeline with standard and off-the-shelf components (vector search, semantic retrieval, LLM/managed rerankers).

 - Establish strong baselines first (prompts, RAG, model selection) before reaching for custom ML.

 - Build evaluation and observability into every stage, with offline and online evaluation.

 - Set up the data/event feedback loops that drive iteration and feed deeper ML later.

 - Improve search relevance and ranking on Patient facing products , raising result quality

 - Own production quality: latency reliability, monitoring, and maintainability.

 - Partner with ML Engineers and collaborate closely with PMs and SWEs to define, build, and ship AI-powered features that deliver measurable value to users and the business.
jobs.requirements_raw:
WHO YOU ARE

Before you read on:  if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You could be our next team mate if you have:

 1. Production deployment: ability to ship algorithms to production (ECS-based service on AWS)

 2. Strong analytical mindset: result-oriented,  patient-first approach

 3. Significant experience as a Software or/and AI engineer shipping search or recommendation systems to production. 

 4. Hands-on experience building end-to-end retrieval: ranking,  reranking pipelines and familiar with nDCG, MAP, Recall@k, MRR

 5. AI-engineering proficiency: turning foundation models and off-the-shelf components into production systems: embeddings & vector search, semantic retrieval, RAG, LLM-based or managed rerankers (e.g. Vertex AI). You can succeed without training a model from scratch

 6. Architecture-first approach: you build the system, baselines, evals, and feedback loops with standard tooling before reaching for custom ML, and know when to partner with ML Engineers to break a ceiling

 7. Evaluation & observability built into every stage (retrieval, ranker, reranker) — offline and online eval, A/B testing, position-bias handling, monitoring

 8. Production deployment — ability to ship reliable, low-latency services to production (hundreds-of-ms SLAs), with care for data quality and long-term maintainability

 

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

 - Experience at a B2C marketplace (e-commerce, hospitality, travel)

 - Additional ML methodologies: pattern mining, recommendation systems, experimentation, or causal inference

 - Have experience with search engines or information retrieval concepts

 - Have exposure to learning-to-rank or feature engineering (for breaking ceilings later, alongside ML Engineers)

 - Have experience in a healthcare or other regulated domain (GDPR / HDS)
   
   


LIFE AT DOCTOLIB TECH

 - Our solutions are built on a single, fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

 - Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

 - We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here https://careers.doctolib.com/ai-careers/.

 - We also invest in open, applied AI research. For example, our DoctoBERT project introduces open-source medical language models trained for French clinical text, with applications in named entity recognition, classification, and retrieval. Read the DoctoBERT practical guide https://huggingface.co/blog/hugging-science/doctobert-cookbook#introduction to learn more about how we bring deep AI research into practical healthcare applications.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site https://careers.doctolib.com/tech-doctolib/.



WHAT WE OFFER

 - Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

 - 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

 - Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

 - Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

 - Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

 - A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

 - 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

 - Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

 - ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave, and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

 - For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

 


THE INTERVIEW PROCESS 

 - A first interview with a member of the Talent Acquisition team

 - A coding interview

 - An agentics system design 

 - A behavioural interview 

 - Reference check 

 


JOB DETAILS

 - Permanent position

 - Full Time 

 - Workplace: Levallois

 - Start date : As soon as possible

 
 

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g. pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process. 

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

jobs.title: Stage - Consolidation et Contrôle financier (x/f/m) - janvier 2027
jobs.description:
Vous êtes passionné(e) par la finance et vous souhaitez vous imprégner des problématiques financières d'une entreprise en pleine croissance ? Vous êtes rigoureux(se), organisé(e) et vous souhaitez comprendre le business model du SaaS ? Ce stage est peut-être fait pour vous !

 


VOS MISSIONS

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

 - Participer à l'animation et l'organisation des clôtures mensuelles en collaboration avec l'équipe comptable et le FP&A, et identifier des pistes d'amélioration

 - Contribuer à la revue des impacts IFRS du Groupe

 - Préparer les écritures de consolidation du Groupe

 - Participer à la préparation de reporting à destination du CFO et du Comex (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash flow Statement)

 - Contribuer au processus budgétaire, notamment sur les prévisions de cash flow
   
   


 


LES QUALITÉS ATTENDUES POUR CE POSTE

Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos attentes, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.

Vous pourrez être le prochain membre de notre équipe si vous :

 - Êtes étudiant(e) en Master 1 ou 2 avec une spécialisation en finance/contrôle de gestion/master Comptabilité, Contrôle & Audit (CCA)

 - Êtes reconnu(e) pour votre organisation, votre rigueur, et savez également être force de proposition

jobs.title: Research Scientist (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
SET A NEW PULSE FOR HEALTHCARE!

We are looking for a Research Scientist to join the Doctolab team (Doctolib Clinical AI Research Lab).

Your mission is to build accurate, well-calibrated, and clinically reliable models of patient health, learned from health data at scale. The work is both fundamental and applied: you publish, and your models reach products used by doctors and patients. Doctolib is used by around 450,000 health professionals and 90 million people across Europe, and research that succeeds in the lab can be deployed at that scale.

Working at Doctolib means contributing to one of Europe's leading health-tech companies, and seeing your work improve care for patients and practitioners.


HOW WE WORK

Doctolab is a research lab in its founding phase, so researchers have real influence over its direction and its priorities. We work closely with the data science and product teams, and we stay close to the data.

We expect researchers to explain why a question matters, not only why it is open. Projects are chosen on both scientific ambition and what they change for patients and practitioners. The work suits researchers who want to see their results used.

The questions we raise are open problems in machine learning: world models that predict the consequences of an action, calibration and uncertainty, causal inference from observational data, multimodal sequence modelling, orchestration between model capabilities. Results on these questions hold well beyond healthcare. We are in a strong position to work on them: we have the data to learn a world model from, a clinical use case that defines success, and the engineering path to put it in front of practitioners and patients and learn from what comes back.

Experience with healthcare or medical data is a plus but not required. Both early-career and experienced researchers are welcome.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

 - Build a world model of patient health: how a health state evolves over time and changes in response to care, learned from observational data with the confounding accounted for

 - Build evaluation methods that test calibration, robustness, interpretability, privacy, and generalization outside the training distribution

 - Work with the data science and product teams to turn research results into clinical-grade features

 - Publish at leading machine learning and health informatics venues

 - Engage the international health and machine learning community through open collaboration: data challenges, shared benchmarks, and open-source releases

 - Help define the lab's research agenda and its working relationship with the rest of the company

MEDICAL DATA INTERN (X/F/M)


SET A NEW PULSE FOR HEALTHCARE!

We are looking for a Medical Data Intern to join the Terminology and Ontology team within the Medical Excellence department at Doctolib in Milan, Italy.

 

At Doctolib, we're setting a new pulse for healthcare. We create AI-powered solutions that help health professionals focus on care and help people prevent, detect, and treat health problems earlier. In this role, you will contribute to making medical information clear, structured, and usable across products for patients, healthcare professionals, and technical teams.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

 - Collect and format sets of terms describing pathologies, allergies, treatments, and other medical concepts, based on standard medical terminologies such as ICD-10 and SNOMED CT.

 - Adapt medical labels to create versions that are understandable to patients and healthcare professionals.

 - Translate labels from English into Italian.

 - Map medical lists of terms across different products.

 - Select and filter terms, then validate your choices with medical experts.

 - Share your work and methodology with the Terminology and Ontology team and product teams.

 - Deliver sets of terms to technical teams in the correct format.






ABOUT OUR DATA ENVIRONMENT

 - Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to the country and healthcare specialty requirements.

 - Our stack is composed of Dagster, dbt, Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, and other technologies.

 - We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here https://careers.doctolib.com/ai-careers/ and learn about our first AI hackathon here https://medium.com/doctolib/building-for-healthcare-our-first-ai-hackathon-aa9d10d1a250!

jobs.description:

Doctolib è alla ricerca di un/una Inside Sales Partner per il nostro team Sales nell'ufficio di Milano. Come Inside Sales Partner, sarai il primo punto di contatto tra Doctolib e i medici specialisti: farai parte di un team di professionisti impegnati a semplificare, attraverso le nostre soluzioni, la vita del personale sanitario e a migliorare l'accesso alla sanità di tutti noi. Seguirai l'intero ciclo di vendita dei servizi offerti da Doctolib, dalla generazione delle opportunità fino alla firma.

Come Inside Sales Partner , ti occuperai di:

Prospecting:

 - Contattare i medici specialisti via telefono, email e altri canali per generare nuove opportunità in modo scalabile

Demo e conversione:

 - Condurre demo online, focalizzandosi sui benefici più rilevanti per la pratica dello specialista

COSA CI ASPETTIAMO DA TE


Prima di continuare a leggere, se il profilo descritto non è perfettamente aderente al tuo attuale profilo professionale, ma ritieni che questa descrizione corrisponda alle tue capacità e alle tue esigenze, ti invitiamo a proseguire!

 - Assicurazione sanitaria integrativa, con la possibilità di includere i familiari conviventi

 - Supporto alla mobilità internazionale e accesso ai nostri tool e programmi di upskilling

 - Contributo forfettario mensile per internet e elettricità

 - Convenzioni aziendali con diversi partner su tutta Italia: Corporate Benefits, Ennevolte, sconti dedicati e promozioni


IL PROCESSO DI SELEZIONE

 - Colloquio con il team di Talent Acquisition

 - Colloquio con l'hiring manager

 - Colloquio finale

 - Almeno una verifica delle referenze

DETTAGLI DELLA POSIZIONE
